jobs.title: Program Manager - Exercise Planning
jobs.description:
**Pay: $190,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year**  

  

**Job Description: Program Manager \- Exercise Planning**  

  

Constellation, Inc. is seeking an accomplished Program Manager (PM) – Exercise Planning to lead planning and exercise support activities for a major Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) consequence management and special\-event planning program. The Program Manager will provide executive leadership, technical direction, and overall accountability for the successful planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of program requirements supporting large\-scale national and international special events.  

The PM will lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for consequence management planning, exercise design and execution, stakeholder engagement, interagency coordination, planning product development, data analysis, executive reporting, and project management. The PM will coordinate activities across FEMA Headquarters, FEMA Regions, Department of Homeland Security (DHS) components, federal interagency partners, state and local stakeholders, and other organizations supporting integrated preparedness and consequence management planning.  

  

**Key Responsibilities*** Serve as the primary program leadership interface with Government stakeholders and provide overall management, technical direction, and accountability for program performance.
* Direct, organize, coordinate, and oversee all exercise planning, consequence management planning, and major special\-event preparedness activities.
* Lead the full exercise lifecycle, including exercise concept development, design, planning, facilitation, conduct, evaluation, reporting, and corrective\-action tracking.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams supporting national\- and regional\-level consequence management planning across multiple venues, jurisdictions, agencies, and operational environments.
* Coordinate with FEMA Headquarters, FEMA Regions, DHS components, federal interagency partners, state and local organizations, and other stakeholders to ensure integrated planning and operational alignment.
* Plan and facilitate planning meetings, workshops, working groups, exercise planning conferences, stakeholder engagements, and senior\-leader activities.
* Oversee development, coordination, validation, maintenance, and presentation of complex planning products, including exercise plans, scenarios, briefing materials, executive summaries, decision documents, reports, timelines, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure exercises effectively validate plans, identify operational gaps, assess coordination mechanisms, and generate actionable observations and recommendations for improving preparedness and consequence management capabilities.
* Manage the Project Management Plan, Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), deliverable tracker, risk and issue log, action\-item tracker, staffing, dependencies, milestones, and program status reporting.
* Identify schedule, staffing, technical, operational, and stakeholder risks; develop mitigation strategies; elevate critical issues; and drive timely resolution.
* Oversee collection, organization, analysis, visualization, and presentation of planning and exercise data to support senior leadership decision\-making.
* Ensure development of professional executive\-level products, including presentations, dashboards, timelines, maps, graphics, infographics, status reports, and decision\-support materials.
* Establish and enforce quality control processes to ensure all planning and exercise deliverables are technically accurate, complete, consistent, timely, professionally presented, and suitable for their intended audiences.
* Maintain configuration management, version control, decision histories, source documentation, action tracking, and knowledge\-management practices across program activities.
* Manage program staffing, workload allocation, personnel performance, surge requirements, and continuity of operations to ensure uninterrupted support during critical planning and exercise periods.
* Provide timely executive\-level reporting on program status, upcoming milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, staffing, exercise readiness, and required Government actions.
* Capture lessons learned, exercise observations, corrective actions, and best practices and incorporate them into subsequent planning and exercise activities.
* Manage transition, knowledge transfer, and closeout activities to preserve Government access to planning products, exercise documentation, schedules, methodologies, decision histories, and institutional knowledge.

  

**Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Emergency Management, Homeland Security, Public Administration, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 10–15 years of progressively responsible experience managing complex federal emergency management, homeland security, exercise planning, consequence management, or major special\-event programs.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale exercise planning and execution, including exercise concept development, design, planning, facilitation, conduct, evaluation, and reporting.
* Demonstrated experience supporting national\- or regional\-level consequence management, emergency preparedness, or major national/international special\-event planning.
* Strong experience coordinating complex activities involving Federal, state, local, regional, and interagency stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and simultaneously oversee multiple planning workstreams, exercises, deliverables, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated program management experience with IMS, project plans, deliverable tracking, risk and issue management, action\-item tracking, performance metrics, and executive status reporting.

jobs.title: Environmental Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Woodard \& Curran is an employee\-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet.  

At Woodard \& Curran, there’s nothing we love more than a tough environmental engineering challenge. We handle a wide range of water and environmental issues—solving complex problems with creativity and tenacity. That’s how we make a difference to our clients, people, and planet. Our company was founded on a simple concept: provide a safe and enjoyable place to work with opportunity, integrity, and commitment, and we will attract talented people. Those people are at the heart of our firm, solving some of the most pressing water and environmental challenges for our clients.  


**What’s in it for you:**

Woodard \& Curran is offering a unique opportunity to join our remediation team, which provides high\-quality permitting, compliance, assessment, remediation, and construction services to a variety of private sector clients including railway clients across the nation. You will manage complex environmental projects including those involving the evaluation and management of PCB\-containing materials that improve our environment and benefit our communities. Our client managers, technical leaders, and team of talented engineers and scientists will help you provide exceptional service to our clients. You will be an active participant in our delivery system improvement programs and continuous learning opportunities.  


**Who are we looking for:**

Woodard \& Curran has an opportunity for a Senior Project Manager to join our growing firm and provide high\-quality consulting services to our industrial, commercial, and railway clients. The selected candidate will be a key member of our national Remediation Practice and work directly with a diverse and talented group of engineers and scientists at the firm. The ideal candidate is a current Senior Project Manager with strong technical experience delivering high\-quality compliance and remediation services, specifically to railroad industry clients located across the firm’s geography and core markets. In addition, the ideal candidate will be sought out by clients for innovative solutions, support and conduct business development efforts, and keep abreast of critical client and industry regulations and issues. The successful candidate will be an energetic, motivated, growth\-oriented professional who can work independently and lead multi\-disciplined project teams.  


**Offering Flexible Remote Schedule**  


**This virtual work schedule will support clients in the following locations:** *Nationwide but primarily in the Northeast and Midwest.*  


**Travel up to 25%:** *Primarily local travel is required.*### **What will you be doing at Woodard \& Curran?**


* Responsibilities include maintaining and establishing relationships with clients to procure and manage the scope, schedule, budget, and delivery of permitting, compliance, remediation and construction projects.
* Work directly with clients and a team to lead the delivery of projects related to providing technical advice, planning, design, permitting, and construction phase services for these projects.
* Frequent interaction with clients, potential clients, owners and regulators. Business development efforts will include preparation of proposals, project interviews and marketing activities.
* Manage and supervise the projects developed utilizing Woodard \& Curran technical and administrative staff.
* Lead and complete technical tasks as required to support the projects. Emergency response opportunities are also a possibility.
* Specific experience and focus areas include developing site investigation plans, evaluating remediation alternatives, reviewing construction plans and related documentation and reporting in accordance with applicable environmental laws and regulations.
* Work also involves the selection, coordination, and management of subcontractors, cost estimating, and management of the scope, schedule, and budget for various project tasks.
* Report writing and interaction with project staff, clients and regulatory agencies will also play an important role in the candidate’s success
### **What You Will Need To Succeed:**


* A total of 15 to 20 plus years of professional experience with an environmental/engineering consulting firm.
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in environmental science or environmental engineering from an accredited program.
* Experience working with railroad clients.
* Strong appreciation of and commitment to safe work practices is mandatory.
* Client focused with an entrepreneurial spirit.
* Demonstrated experience with scoping, budgeting and implementation of complex permitting and compliance programs.
* Familiarity with railroad regulatory programs across northeastern and midwestern states.
* Ability to work independently and on large multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Outstanding written and verbal skills.
* Demonstrated leadership and ability to mentor and develop a project team.
* OSHA HAZWOPER 40\-hour and Railway Worker safety training a plus

Final compensation will be determined based on these factors and adjusted, where applicable, by a geographic differential. As a result, the compensation range for this position may vary depending on where the successful candidate is located and performs their work. The Staff Security Analyst is an advanced security operations professional who leads the design, execution, and continuous improvement of Alkami's threat detection and incident response capabilities across the enterprise. This role applies broad technical expertise to solve highly complex security challenges, strengthen detection engineering, and influence operational security strategy through cross\-functional collaboration and technical leadership. Operating with significant independence, the incumbent partners with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and technology leaders to improve organizational resilience, mature security operations capabilities, and enable rapid, effective response to evolving cyber threats.
**Key Responsibilities \& Duties:**

* Lead complex incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident improvements.
* Design, implement, and mature enterprise threat detection capabilities using SIEM analytics, endpoint detection, cloud monitoring, behavioral analytics, and automated response workflows.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify advanced attacker behaviors, emerging threats, and indicators of compromise.
* Develop and maintain enterprise detection engineering standards, playbooks, tuning methodologies, and quality practices.
* Partner with Security Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Identity, and Application Security teams to strengthen security controls and reduce organizational risk.
* Lead forensic investigations across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and application environments.
* Evaluate emerging threats, adversary techniques, threat intelligence, and detection technologies to improve monitoring and response capabilities.
* Develop automation and orchestration workflows to improve operational efficiency and response speed.
* Establish and report on operational metrics related to detection effectiveness, incident response performance, and security operations maturity.
* Advise technology teams on monitoring strategies, logging requirements, incident readiness, and detection coverage.
* Mentor Security Analysts through technical guidance, investigation reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to enterprise security strategy, architecture reviews, and long\-term cybersecurity planning.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Legal teams to support regulatory, customer, and audit requirements.
* Research emerging attack techniques, AI\-enabled threats, and evolving security operations technologies to continuously enhance security capabilities.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 6–10 years of experience in security operations, threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, cybersecurity engineering, or a related information security discipline, including broad experience leading complex enterprise security investigations and detection engineering initiatives across multiple technology domains.
* Advanced incident response leadership and threat detection engineering
* Expertise with SIEM, endpoint detection and response, cloud security monitoring, identity monitoring, and email security platforms
* Advanced threat hunting, digital forensics, malware analysis, and adversary behavior analysis
* Expert knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK, threat intelligence, detection engineering, and incident response frameworks
* Security automation, orchestration, and operational workflow optimization
* Ability to lead complex cross\-functional security investigations and influence technical stakeholders
* Strong analytical, investigative, and executive communication skills
* Ability to independently solve highly complex operational security challenges

**Desired Skills:**

* GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, SC\-200, CISSP, or comparable advanced cybersecurity certification
* Experience supporting regulated financial services environments
* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Chronicle, or comparable enterprise security platforms
* Experience developing enterprise detection engineering standards and security automation
* Experience leading major incident response activities and security operations maturity initiatives

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Kellermeyer Bergensons Services (KBS) is the largest privately held provider of facility services in North America, servicing over **2 billion square feet of space daily**. We help industry leaders across a wide range of key verticals—including **retail, industrial and logistics, healthcare, education, manufacturing, and more**—maintain clean, efficient, and welcoming spaces that support their operations. As we continue to grow, we are looking for team members who are dedicated, reliable, and ready to contribute to a culture built on respect, opportunity, and pride in service.

  

We are seeking a **Cyber Security Analyst** to monitor, investigate, and responds to security threats across KBS and its subsidiaries’ networks, endpoints, and cloud environments. This role combines proactive threat hunting, analytics, and automation to detect, contain, and mitigate cyber risks. The analyst plays a key role in strengthening enterprise defenses, improving visibility, and supporting continuous improvement of the company’s overall security posture.

 ***This role is a remote opportunity .***

  

**Position Summary**


The Cyber Security Analyst configures, implements, monitors, investigates, and responds to security threats across KBS and its subsidiaries' networks, endpoints, and cloud environments. The role requires deep working knowledge of the security capabilities available in AWS and Microsoft 365, along with the ability to quickly gain command of the KBS security tool stack.

  

The analyst works closely with the rest of the security team and with cross\-departmental functions, including Software Engineering and DevOps, guiding best practices and control implementation and explaining the tradeoffs behind each recommendation. This position calls for a self\-motivated team player who takes initiative, works effectively with minimal supervision, and understands how to balance strong security with business productivity.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

* Apply AWS security best practices across identity, network, workload, and data services, covering areas such as IAM roles and permission scoping, VPC and edge controls, container and serverless compute, storage and databases, and encryption and key management, assessed against the AWS Well\-Architected Security Pillar.
* Own AWS security posture, creating platform visibility through the SIEM and driving measurable improvement over time, working with Software Engineering, DevOps, and other stakeholders to see that security requirements are implemented to standard.
* Configure and tune Microsoft 365 security capabilities across endpoint, identity, email, and data protection, including the Defender suite, Purview data protection and insider risk management, and Entra ID access controls such as Conditional Access and privileged access.
* Actively hunt for indicators of compromise, suspicious activity, and adversarial behavior across endpoint, identity, email, network, and cloud environments using CrowdStrike and other EDR/XDR platforms, escalating or remediating as appropriate.
* Identify repetitive security operations work and automate it across detection, control enforcement, and response using SOAR, Python, PowerShell, or infrastructure as code.
* Develop and execute CQL and KQL queries and build dashboards to analyze telemetry from Microsoft, CrowdStrike, AWS, and related sources.
* Participate in red/blue team exercises, simulations, and post\-incident reviews to identify and reduce areas of vulnerability/exposure and improve readiness.
* Create and improve security baselines, detection rules, and playbooks to enhance visibility and reduce response time.
* Prepare reports and documentation on incidents, improvements, and overall security posture.
* Ensure alignment with internal policies, industry standards, and relevant security frameworks.
* Stay current on new platform capabilities and emerging attack vectors, applying a proactive, inquisitive, and analytical mindset to surface overlooked threats.

**Additional Duties and Responsibilities**


As required by management.

 **Knowledge, Skills and Competencies**

* Hands\-on AWS security configuration experience across identity, network, and data services is required.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and compliance across identity, endpoint, email, and collaboration workloads.
* Able to present platform options and tradeoffs and commit to a clear recommendation.
* Hands\-on experience using CQL to build queries and dashboards is required. Working knowledge of KQL.
* EDR/XDR and SIEM platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender), plus email security platforms (Abnormal Security).
* Experience with Python or PowerShell scripting for automation and incident enrichment, and with infrastructure as code for configuration enforcement.
* Threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and incident response methodologies.
* Understanding of common threat frameworks (MITRE ATT\&CK, Cyber Kill Chain).
* Analytical and detail\-oriented with strong problem\-solving ability.
* Self\-motivated and dependable, working effectively with minimal supervision.
* Collaborative communicator with cross\-departmental awareness.
* Curious and proactive, committed to continuous learning and process improvement.

*Experience Required:*

* Background in solutions architecture or systems engineering, with demonstrated ability to select among available platform services rather than only operate a fixed configuration. Preferred.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

  

This Job Description is for DoD SkillBridge participation and is not eligible for direct hire.

  

CrowdStrike’s DoD SkillBridge / Career Skills Program (CSP) Internship is an approved SkillBridge Program under Dept. of Defense Instruction 1322\.29 as enacted by 10 U.S.C. Sec 1143\. Eligibility is restricted to members of the U.S. Armed Forces separating honorably with greater than 180 days of continuous Active Duty. SkillBridge/CSP period of eligibility is within the final 180 days of Active\-Duty service, and the SkillBridge/CSP must be completed prior to separation from Active Duty in the U.S. Armed Forces.

  

CrowdStrike’s DoD SkillBridge/CSP Internship is open to members of all services, and all ranks and experience levels. Service members should fully review SkillBridge/CSP Job Description for requirements and qualifications of the individual position. SkillBridge participants participate in full time training with industry (40\-hour work week) under permissive temporary duty military orders and are not eligible for compensation from CrowdStrike during SkillBridge participation but will continue to receive all military wages and benefits as defined by the Department of Defense. DoD SkillBridge/CSP is fully compliant with FLSA, DBA, SCA, CSHSSA and all other pertinent Federal and State labor laws. For more employer information regarding DoD SkillBridge/CSP, please visit the Department of Defense DoD SkillBridge website at https://skillbridge.osd.mil/

**About the Role:**


The mission of the Intelligence Analyst is to directly support cyber threat customers and to ensure our customers realize the full value of the Intelligence product they have purchased from CrowdStrike; ultimately maximizing customer success and renewals. Analysts are responsible for working with multiple customers to manage the customer's Falcon Intel Recon module. This role will serve as a cyber intel analytic interface between CrowdStrike's Falcon Intelligence Recon customers and the wider CrowdStrike intelligence team, enabling effective use of cyber threat intelligence between clients and the Falcon Intel Recon application.

**Key Qualifications:**


Ideal candidates possess strong technical expertise in dark web intelligence and threat intelligence, complemented by exceptional customer engagement skills across technical and executive levels. You should demonstrate a proven ability to independently manage multiple concurrent workstreams and have a genuine passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences. The role requires understanding and addressing customer needs at all organizational levels, from C\-suite executives to security analysts.

**What You'll Do:**

* Drive high levels of customer satisfaction, maintaining a strong sense of ownership over many customer relationships.
* Quickly triage and escalate noteworthy findings from Falcon Intelligence Recon to the respective customers
* Guide customers through Falcon Intelligence Recon findings and providing subject matter expertise
* Be a strong voice for customers into the Intelligence and Engineering teams to improve the product and ensure that customer's feedback, feature requests, and overall satisfaction is conveyed and accounted for.
* Plan and lead process improvement initiatives tailored to improve overall customer satisfaction with the CrowdStrike team.

**What You'll Need:**

* Working knowledge of cyber threat intelligence, all\-source threat intelligence analysis, or intelligence collections and be fully versed in the intelligence lifecycle
* Excellent written, verbal communication skills in English
* Working knowledge of cyber threat intelligence terminology, key concepts, and analysis
* Knowledge of the dark and deep web ecosystems, including actors, forums, and leak sites
* Adaptable and willing to learn new technologies
* Customer service attitude and willingness to help and problem\-solve with customers
* Ability to operate independently and with little direction.
* Ability to present and explain technology to people with less technical knowledge
* Must be able to thrive in a fast paced, high stress start up environment and able to create customer solutions with limited resources
* Knowledge of data communication concepts and technologies, specifically email, networking, and enterprise security
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

**Bonus Points:**

* Ability to use AI tools and familiarity with application programming interfaces (API) as a delivery method for indicators and intelligence.

 **Travel:**Minimal to light travel (25%)

Sibylline is a leading intelligence and strategic risk consultancy in the security sector. Since 2010 we have supported businesses, governments and NGOs through the provision of high\-quality risk analysis, due diligence and consultancy services. The firm provides an innovative, entrepreneurial and fast\-growing working environment, offering employees ever greater exposure to high profile clients and challenges. Sibylline offers fantastic opportunities for career progression within a successful company, and we aim to help our employees to build their own personal profiles as well\-regarded analysts within the broader industry.


Key attributes of Sibylline employees are:


Self\-motivated, and auto\-improving individuals who can couple initiative and boldness with good judgement

* Excellent written and spoken English
* Clarity of thought and analytical flair
* Strong, demonstrable interest in security and intelligence
* The ability to work under pressure, demonstrate leadership when required but also be able to collaborate effectively in teams
* Excellent attention to detail

  

**Job Description** **Position Summary:**


We are seeking an experienced Intelligence professional to join our team in an embedded Team Lead role supporting a global technology company. Working remotely (eligible states) from within the United States and reporting directly to the client’s Security Manager, the successful candidate will lead a small team of embedded analysts responsible for delivering timely, actionable intelligence across the Americas and Europe. This role offers the opportunity to shape and mature an intelligence program while building trusted partnerships with stakeholders in a fast\-paced and collaborative environment.


The Team Lead will oversee intelligence collection, monitoring, analysis, and reporting efforts to identify emerging threats, incidents, risks, and trends that may impact the client’s people, assets, operations, and reputation. In addition to producing high\-quality intelligence assessments and briefings, the successful candidate will provide day\-to\-day leadership to the analyst team, establish intelligence priorities, support complex investigations, and drive continuous improvement across reporting, workflows, and program performance. The role requires strong analytical judgment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable intelligence that supports operational and strategic decision\-making.


This is a full\-time remote position based in the United States, working standard business hours Monday through Friday. The successful candidate will work closely with client stakeholders and Sibylline support teams to ensure the continued delivery and growth of a high\-performing intelligence program while supporting the development and success of the embedded analyst team.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - remote
jobs.description:
Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives. We blend cutting\-edge technology with compassionate, high\-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country. At Career Team, we're solving today's unemployment challenges with smart software, world\-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you'll feel right at home here.

**Senior Project Manager**



Career Edge is a fully integrated career readiness and case management software system supporting workforce and education entities. Our goal is simple and relentless: sustained employment for career seekers, real results for employers, and stronger communities. We sell and implement enterprise software to state agencies and large workforce systems, and we are judged on whether those implementations land. The mission is why we do it; delivery is what earns us the right to keep doing it.


**TITLE:** Senior Project Manager


**REPORTS TO:** VP of Project Management Office


**LOCATION:** Remote


**EMPLOYMENT TYPE:** Full\-Time, Exempt Employee



Enterprise workforce systems have run on the same software and the same delivery playbook for decades. We're replacing both \- one state, one agency, one implementation at a time. As a Senior Project Manager, you're where that promise gets kept. You lead complex, enterprise\-level client implementations and internal initiatives from concept through go\-live, and you own whether they land.



Here's the part most job descriptions won't tell you. We need someone who loves process enough to hold a cross\-functional team accountable to it, and who can build a new one where none exists yet. Most people have one of those instincts. We need both, in one person, and we screen hard for it. The role is new \- created by bigger contracts and more concurrent implementations than our current team can carry, not by a vacancy. Practically, that means some of the scaffolding you'd expect at a mature PMO isn't built yet, and building it is part of the job. If you've only ever delivered inside an established PMO \- governance handed to you, a template for every artifact, someone senior who owns the escalation \- that gap will feel like work rather than opportunity, and we'd rather you know that now.


**The Shape of the Job**



Portfolio size depends on what we win: one large statewide implementation as your whole world, or two to three concurrent mid\-size engagements. Implementations run several months, typically more than a year.



The structure is matrixed. You have no direct reports, but you direct the Business Analysts, Solutions Architects, and Engineering Leads on your engagements, and mentor the PMs assisting you. On the client side you're the primary point of contact for agency program leadership and their executive sponsors.


**What You'll Own**


* **Delivery, end to end.** Own enterprise\-level client implementations from discovery through go\-live \- on scope, on time, and at a quality bar you set and defend. When delivery is humming, it's because you built the plan; when something's stuck, you're already in the room clearing it.
* **The client relationship.** Be the strategic point of contact across the project lifecycle. Build executive\-level trust, run discovery and alignment sessions that pin down scope, business outcomes, success metrics, and risk \- and keep senior stakeholders aligned when their priorities collide.
* **The translation layer.** Turn business objectives into delivery roadmaps, milestones, and measurable outcomes the internal team can actually execute against. Guide the hard trade\-off calls on timelines, resourcing, and long\-term scalability.
* **Cross\-functional execution.** Direct the work across Project Managers, Business Analysts, Solutions Architects, and Engineering Leads. You lead the high\-level conversations on data migration readiness, timeline impacts, and cross\-team dependencies without getting pulled into the technical execution yourself.
* **Risk, before it's a fire.** Spot delivery risk early, build the mitigation, and make the call, handling routine turbulence yourself without reflexively escalating and raising the flag loudly when the work genuinely needs it.
* **Readiness and adoption.** Guide UAT planning from a business\-readiness lens, and shape rollout plans, client training strategies, and the long\-game adoption success that turns a go\-live into a lasting win.


**Why This Role**


* Real ownership and real impact: your outcomes directly move client satisfaction, our credibility, and long\-term account growth.
* Small enough that you work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the executive team and your judgment visibly changes the company. And small enough that the delivery infrastructure is still being built. If getting to shape it reads as the best part of the job rather than a caveat, you'll fit here \- we work hard, we win together, and it's genuinely fun.


**Who You Are**


* **A process builder and a process breaker.** You hold teams accountable to the plan because you know that's what protects the client. You have the judgment to see when a process is getting in the way of the outcome \- and the nerve to redesign it without blowing up everything that already works.
* **Calm in ambiguity, sharp in structure.** You bring a steady, confident presence to a room full of competing priorities, and you're energized \- not rattled \- when the path isn't drawn yet. You create the structure others navigate by \- and you're the steadiest person on the call when a go\-live date is slipping and the client's leadership is listening.
* **A relationship\-builder unafraid of the direct conversation.** When priorities collide, you have the candid talk that gets everyone aligned and leaves the partnership stronger. You know how t

jobs.description:
About Patra:

Patra is an outcome\-focused operating partner working exclusively for the insurance industry. Combining expert global teams, process intelligence, and purpose\-built technology, Patra delivers measurable results to clients. With 20 years of deep domain expertise, exceptional client retention rates, and significant sustained investment in AI, Patra partners with agencies, brokers, MGAs, MGUs, and carriers to transform how insurance operations are delivered.


Core Duties:

The Technical Project Manager will drive the AI Development Lifecycle (AI‑DLC) where AI agents contribute across development and quality processes, and Human‑in‑the‑Loop (HITL) engineers govern their output. Acting as delivery lead, change agent, and AI practitioner, this role adapts delivery rituals, sets governance and review standards, and embeds AI tooling into daily workflows to keep the human layer effective and accountable.  

Working with Product and Engineering counterparts, the Technical Project Manager will act as the Project Management leader to create, implement and improve delivery models and drive development outcomes. **Summary****Responsible**
---------------

  

Lead adoption of the AI Development Lifecycle and HITL delivery, and develop governance, policy, and tooling to ensure scalable, auditable human oversight of agent‑augmented work. Keep current with rapid advancements in software development to drive continuous improvements in the AI\-DLC. **Accountable**

* Audit pass rate/compliance score

* Token cost per deliverable
* Agent autonomy
* Code quality

* Governance \& policy — contribute and enforce HITL governance, review standards, audit cadence, and compliance requirements.
* People leadership \& coaching — mentor engineers, product owners, and cross‑functional stakeholders on hybrid delivery practices and responsible AI use.
* Stakeholder alignment — coordinate with Sales, Client Success, Security, and Finance to align delivery with commercial and risk objectives.
* Performance measurement — set KPI framework (DORA/SPACE adapted for HITL), establish targets, and translate metrics into executive narratives.
* Vendor \& partner oversight — set briefs, success metrics, and quality standards for external partners and managed services.

* Tooling ownership — administer Jira and Confluence configurations, automation rules, templates, and data hygiene to reflect HITL workflows.
* Quality assurance \& incident response — monitor change failure rate, MTTR, and remediation actions; ensure human oversight on agent‑contributed work.
* Automation \& scale — design and implement automation to reduce manual review where safe, and scale repeatable delivery motions.

jobs.description:
**RESEARCH ANALYST**
====================


**Who we are**
--------------


Action Research works with child welfare systems across the country, providing research, data analysis, and strategic support to strengthen policy and practice and improve outcomes for children, youth, and families. We partner with government leaders, frontline staff, think tanks, service providers, lived experience experts, and foundations to generate insights and drive system reform. We are nationally recognized for our child welfare expertise and for translating rigorous research and analysis into practical guidance for child welfare leaders.
**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------


Action Research seeks an enthusiastic, curious, and self\-motivated individual with strong quantitative analytic skills and experience contributing to applied research or policy analysis. The Research Analyst will primarily support system\-level child welfare reform efforts arising from federal class action litigation, with a focus on analyzing administrative data, validating performance measures, and assessing states’ progress toward reform goals. The candidate must have professional experience with applied research and some knowledge of child welfare systems.
This is an excellent opportunity for an early\- to mid\-career applied researcher who wants to strengthen their analytic skills, contribute to consequential public sector work, and develop a rich understanding of child welfare reform efforts across multiple jurisdictions.
Ideal candidates will have:
* *A commitment to improving outcomes for vulnerable children, youth, and families* – you recognize that involvement with the child welfare system can have lasting effects on children and families and are committed to advancing work that helps children remain safe, stable, and connected to family;
* *A dedication to using data to generate actionable insights* – you see data as a powerful tool for understanding how systems operate, assessing progress, and informing change;
* *Strong analytic reasoning* – you are curious about the story behind the data, able to identify patterns and inconsistencies, and interested in understanding what findings mean in practice;
* *Strong task management skills* – you have experience managing multiple tasks across projects, meeting deadlines, and communicating proactively about progress, competing priorities, and emerging concerns;
* *Great attention to detail* – you recognize the importance of getting it right, and are comfortable operating on a team where we check and recheck our work;
* *Comfort working both independently and collaboratively* – you can advance tasks on your own, are excited to collaborate with others, know when to ask colleagues for support, and contribute actively to the communication and camaraderie that sustain a small, fully remote team; and
* *A learning mindset –* you are comfortable entering unfamiliar substantive areas, asking thoughtful questions, and steadily building the knowledge needed to produce sound analysis.

We are committed to inclusion, embrace diversity as an organization, and believe these values are essential to our work. The American child welfare system has a history of disproportionately impacting families of color, low\-income communities, and LGBTQ\+ youth. As an organization working to make child welfare systems more responsive to children, youth and families and more effective in its services and operations, we believe our staff should reflect diverse backgrounds, experiences, and cultures.
**Role you would play**
-----------------------


Working with a small, dedicated team, the Research Analyst will analyze administrative data and support the assessment of child welfare system performance across multiple jurisdictions. The primary responsibility in this role is to support reform efforts initiated through federal class action litigation and settlement agreements. In several states and localities, child advocates have sued public child welfare systems in federal class action lawsuits. The lawsuits focus on issues such as the safety of children in foster care, the services received by children and their families, and the availability of appropriate and stable foster care homes. In many states, court\-appointed monitors oversee the implementation of reforms resulting from these lawsuits and settlement agreements.
Action Research supports court monitoring teams in four states: Kansas, Michigan, New Mexico, and Texas. We analyze administrative data, assess data quality, and independently validate calculations used to measure system performance and reform progress. Our analysis helps ensure that court monitors, judges, state child welfare leaders, and other partners have accurate and useful information about the progress of reform and outcomes for children and families.
#### **Specific activities may include but are not limited to the following:**


* *Data cleaning and quality assessment –* cleaning, organizing, and documenting administrative data; identifying and resolving errors, inconsistencies, duplicates, missing values, and formatting issues; and assessing the data’s completeness, reliability, and suitability for analysis.
* *Data analysis –* writing and executing reproducible, well\-documented syntax or code to analyze large and complex administrative datasets accurately and efficiently.
* *Performance validation –* replicating and independently validating performance calculations submitted by public agencies.
* *Quality assurance –* reviewing data, code, calculations, tables, written findings, and colleagues’ analytic work for accuracy, consistency, and clarity.
* *Communicating findings* – interpreting analytic results and translating them into clear technical memos, internal materials, public reports, presentations, and other products for technical and nontechnical audiences.
* *Partner engagement –* presenting and discussing analytic findings with colleagues, court monitoring

The ideal candidate brings strong critical thinking \- able to decompose an unclear business problem, challenge the assumptions behind a request, and choose the right approach rather than simply building what was asked \- paired with fluent, hands\-on use of AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot to accelerate analysis, automate manual work, and design solutions that scale. As AI reshapes BI work, we expect this role to actively apply it, not just be aware of it.


**Principal Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and manage business intelligence solutions on complex projects of large scope \- dashboards, reports, ad\-hoc datasets, and visualizations that guide business decisions.
* Partner with Product, Actuarial \& Advanced Analytics, Underwriting, and other core insurance functions to collect, structure, and validate data from multiple sources.
* Audit, compile, and reconcile data to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Communicate findings clearly to business stakeholders and senior leaders \- translating technical analysis into plain\-language recommendations, defending methodology when challenged, and providing consultative input beyond what was asked.
* Automate manual reporting processes and build scalable, reusable solutions rather than one\-off deliverables.
* Apply AI tools (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and similar) to accelerate dashboard development, pipeline automation, code generation and review, and report QA \- and champion AI\-driven process improvement across the BI function.
* Apply critical thinking to ambiguous requests \- clarify the underlying business question, evaluate trade\-offs, and recommend the approach rather than defaulting to the one requested.
* Conduct peer reviews of colleagues' work and mentor less experienced analysts as the Power BI subject matter expert.
* Support the implementation of new practices, processes, and procedures.

**Education, Experience, Skills \& Abilities**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* 5–7 years of data analytics or related experience.
* Advanced SQL, data modeling, and visualization; recognized Power BI subject matter expertise (Tableau or other BI tools a plus).
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric ecosystem, including:
	+ OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Notebooks, Pipelines, Dataflows, Power BI integration, and Python for Fabric Notebooks.
* Solid grasp of database structures, relationships, and dependencies.
* Strong critical thinking and proactive problem\-solving \- comfortable working from an ambiguous request to a defined, scalable solution.
* Strong written and verbal communication with business stakeholders and senior leaders; able to present findings and influence decisions without technical jargon.
* Peer mentoring and peer review capabilities.
* Intermediate insurance domain knowledge and understanding of MGA operations; insurance industry experience preferred.
* Advanced, hands\-on AI fluency \- daily working use of tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot. Candidates should be prepared to describe a specific problem they solved or automated with AI. Specifically:
	+ Accelerating analysis, report automation, SQL/Python code generation and review, and documentation.
	+ Effective prompting and AI workflow design, with the judgment to validate AI output.
* Strong proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, formulas, charts, and graphing).

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Program: Comprehensive Legal Services to Unaccompanied Alien Children (UAC) – Program Management Office (PMO) Contract



Customer: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) – Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR), Washington, D.C. Capital Area



Work Location: 100% Remote Telework (U.S.\-based)



Employment Type: Full\-Time / W\-2



Clearance: Must be a U.S. Citizen and able to obtain and maintain an HHS Public Trust background investigation


#### **POSITION SUMMARY**


The Data Analyst turns program data into decisions for the CPMC PMO supporting the HHS/ORR UAC Legal Services contract. This role builds and maintains the reporting layer that sits over Microsoft Dynamics 365, SharePoint, and subcontractor data feeds, and produces the recurring dashboards, ad\-hoc analyses, and data calls required by HHS/ORR and CPMC leadership. All work is performed on de\-identified program operations data — this role does not access personally identifiable information about UAC beneficiaries.


#### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, build, and maintain program dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI (and Excel) drawing from Microsoft Dynamics 365, SharePoint, and subcontractor data feeds.
* Respond to HHS/ORR and CPMC PMO data calls with accurate, auditable, welldocumented analyses.
* Build and maintain the program's data dictionary, data lineage, and qualitycontrol checks on all reported metrics.
* Partner with Finance, Subcontracts, and Quality to align KPIs and ensure one source of truth across the PMO.
* Perform trend analysis, variance analysis, and forecasting on program performance, subcontractor throughput, and financial burn.
* Automate recurring reporting using Power Query, Power Automate, and Dynamics 365 native reporting.
* Support adhoc analysis for the Program Manager, including scenario modeling and rootcause investigations.
* Document all reporting logic and hand off runbooks to Quality and Finance.
* Adhere to HHS datahandling requirements and CPMC informationsecurity policies at all times.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* U.S. Citizenship (required for HHS background investigation).
* Ability to obtain and maintain an HHS Public Trust background investigation.
* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 35 years of data analyst experience supporting federal programs, with HHS customer experience strongly preferred.
* Strong handson experience pulling and reporting on data from Microsoft Dynamics 365\.
* Expertlevel Microsoft Excel and Power BI; working SQL skills.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous requests into structured analyses and clear visualizations.

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with Power Automate, Power Apps, and SharePoint list reporting.
* Python or R for adhoc statistical analysis.
* Prior experience supporting an HHS/ORR, ACF, or immigrationrelated program.
* Understanding of federal data governance and privacy requirements.

#### **ABOUT CPMC, LLC**


CPMC is a Service\-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that makes complex program management concepts simple. With our structured consulting, analytic tools, and training service methodologies, we help organizations accomplish a vast array of program management goals — from establishing and running the Program Management Office (PMO) for the long term to training individual learners on the foundation concepts of Program Management.


#### **PROGRAM OVERVIEW**


CPMC is standing up the Program Management Office (PMO) and the Contracts/Subcontracts function supporting HHS's comprehensive legal services program for Unaccompanied Alien Children (UAC) who are currently in — or have been released from — Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR) custody. CPMC does not deliver any direct legal services under this contract; our scope is limited to PMO oversight, governance, financial administration, and subcontractor management on behalf of HHS. This position directly supports that mission.


#### **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**


CPMC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prospective employees will receive consideration without discrimination. CPMC does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, ethnic or national origin, age, disability, familial status, sexual orientation, genetic and family medical information, gender identity, political affiliation, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, personal appearance, matriculation or any other basis that is protected under applicable Federal and local laws ("Protected Classes").

jobs.description:

We are hiring a Sales Strategy Analyst to support the Tesla Megapack sales team by building practical tools, improving and codifying processes, and creating scalable resources that make the organization more efficient. This role focuses on turning ad\-hoc work into repeatable, well\-documented processes and tools that improve deal velocity and reduce friction for the sales team.


You will own process improvement initiatives (including post\-contract workflows and deal data management), create enablement assets, and support the Contracts Manager and Sales Specialist. The goal is to build longer\-term team capabilities through better processes, AI\-powered tools, and documented best practices.


This is a high\-autonomy individual\-contributor role with coaching and oversight from the Sales Strategy Leader. It is ideal for someone early in their career who is eager to learn, build, and have a direct impact on how the sales team operates.


This internal\-facing position requires a deep understanding of sales dynamics and the battery industry, supporting Tesla’s mission to accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy through innovative solutions and exponential business growth.

jobs.description:
About Us:

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.  

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.  

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Working closely with the end Customer, vendors, and project personnel, the Senior Project Manager is responsible for ensuring the proper implementation and delivery of an Advanced Distribution Management System, within our client’s territory.  

You will have responsibility for all aspects of the project over the entire project lifecycle including responsibility for assembling and managing the delivery teams, assigning individual responsibilities, identifying appropriate resources needed, setting up and managing the Vendors and Subcontractors engagements, and developing schedules to ensure timely completion of the project. In addition, you must exercise/demonstrate judgement, leadership, organization, and communication skills.  

The Sr. Project Manager will be an essential part of our team to grow the consulting practice in the Operational Technology and Real\-Time Systems domain.  

The Sr. Project Manager should have experience deploying GE ADMS systems.


Responsibilities:
* Deliver project(s) to completion. You will own the scope, cost, schedule, and risks for the project and manage multiple tracks, business and technical resources, consultants and vendors contracted to deliver solutions.
* Development of contractual Statement of Works with Client and Suppliers articulating precise assumptions and limit of responsibilities
* Ability to strategize and implement methodology to increase project margins
* The entire project team will report to you, and you will be ultimately responsible for assigning work, monitoring, and measuring the team’s outputs, escalating resource gaps or shortfall of individuals
* You will be TRC’s representative, ensuring that the Client and TRC's interests are well aligned for the success of the project.
* Manage the Vendors, ensuring that the Contractual, operational and relationship aspects are well aligned for the success of the project.
* Acting as a champion to foster a positive project work environment; and successfully lead the team to accomplish all the project objectives on time and on budget
* Develop the workflow plans to manage the project from initial request through systems analysis, technical design, implementation, procurement, testing, turnover to production and client migration.
* Plan, prepare, and track project schedules and budgets to assure controlled completion of each project step.
* Prepare and maintain a risk assessment and mitigation action plan
* Maintain resource forecasts to assure that schedule compliance and desired results are achieved.
* Update the company and external stakeholders on project progress, changes from original plans, and existing or emerging risks.
* Lead the project core team meetings Present project progress at Steering Committee level with participation of senior executives from TRC or from the Client.


Qualifications:
* Minimum of 10 years of Project Management experience in the utility domain.
* Previous experience leading and managing large\-scale, multifaceted enterprise\-wide Operational Technologies Projects in an electric or gas utility environment.
* The successful candidate will be fully knowledgeable and proficient in all aspects of the project management Body of Knowledge.
* Excellent organizational, decision making and presentation skills.
* Excellent communication skills ranging from addressing C\-Level to multiple technical teams.
* Ability to self\-direct and work independently as well as in a team environment.
* Excellent team building and motivational skills.
* Excellent budgeting and financial skills.
* Proficiency with MS\-Project and with MS Office Suite: Excel, PowerPoint, Word.
* Must have strong judgement, leadership, organization, and communication skills.
* Ability to travel up to 50% or on an as needed basis to the client location.
* Previous experience implementing large ADMS programs, preferably on the technology vendor side.
* PMP Certification.

Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.
401k package that includes both traditional and Roth IRA options and Company match.
Paid time off contingent upon full time or part time status and level of seniority (ranging from 15 to 25 days per year).
All full\-time employees enjoy a minimum of 8 Paid Holidays per year.

jobs.description:
The Wallet \& Apple Pay PMO is looking for a driven, design\-minded Engineering Project Manager to help ship experiences used by hundreds of millions of people every day. This is an exciting environment where technical fluency, design partnership, and sound judgment under ambiguity are keys to success. If you possess unshakeable integrity, genuine curiosity, and the range to move seamlessly between leadership briefings and engineering triage, we'd love to hear from you!  

  

**Description**  

  

In this role, you will manage projects and support roadmap execution for the Wallet client engineering teams, focusing on delivering the UI and experiences that bring new Wallet capabilities to life. You will partner directly with engineering managers, Human Interface producers, and cross\-functional groups across Apple. Under the guidance of PMO leadership, you will help drive the scoping, planning, and execution of key initiatives \- coordinating design deliverables against engineering milestones and ensuring teams stay aligned so features launch on time and at the quality our users expect.","responsibilities":"Work closely with the app engineers responsible for building the Wallet UI to plan, track, and manage the development of features and release of our software.  

  

Partner with our Human Interface producers and designers to plan design deliverables against engineering milestones, ensuring specs, assets, and design decisions land in time to keep development on schedule.  

  

Coordinate cross\-functional work streams spanning engineering, design, and quality, and represent program status to stakeholders at all levels.  

  

Proactively surface risk, drive timely decisions, and unblock teams \- including navigating the privacy, security, and financial\-partner review cycles specific to your domain.  

  

Own release quality and stability commitments for the client UI, balancing engineering constraints against design fidelity and timeline.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Experience partnering with mobile/native client engineering teams (iOS, Android, or embedded) through the full build\-test\-release cycle.  

  

Familiarity with modern engineering workflows, including standard bug\-tracking systems, GitHub, and AI\-assisted development tools  

  

Prior experience mentoring or setting process direction for other EPMs.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

7\+ years of project management experience in a technical software development environment, including experience coordinating with design or design\-production teams.  

  

Strong track record coordinating cross\-functional work streams across engineering, design, and quality to deliver high quality features with minimal supervision, at a company/product operating at large scale.  

  

Experience managing feature delivery in regulated or high\-consequence domains with compliance, security, or bank/financial\-partner review gates (e.g., payments, identity, or health).  

  

Proven ability to proactively identify risks, drive decision\-making, and unblock teams.  

  

Demonstrated ability to navigate technical ambiguity, triage development bugs, and drive cross\-functional decision\-making under minimal supervision.  

  

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.  

  

BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,500 and $311,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI) leverages technology to drive opportunity, improve public safety, and help government run better across New York City. From delivering affordable broadband to protecting against cybersecurity threats and building digital government services, OTI is at the forefront of how the city delivers for New Yorkers in the 21st century. Follow us on social media @NYCOfficeofTech, and visit www.nyc.gov/oti to learn more.
  

  

At OTI, we offer great benefits, and the chance to work on projects that have a meaningful impact on millions of people. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology and collaborate with other passionate professionals who share your drive and commitment to making a difference through technology.
  

  

About Cyber Command
  

Cyber Command is charged with protecting all City systems against cyber threats, including systems that deliver vital services to New Yorkers. Headed by the Chief Information Security Officer of the City of New York, we provide in\-depth support to over 100 agencies and offices to protect, detect, identify, respond to, and recover from cyber threats.
  

  

The Senior Threat Analyst position at NYC Cyber Command is mandated as part of a critical initiative due to the escalating cybersecurity threats faced by the city's infrastructure, public services, and sensitive data. In an era where cyberattacks are becoming increasingly sophisticated and prevalent, the role of a Senior Threat Analyst is paramount in fortifying the city's defenses, analyzing emerging threats, and developing proactive measures to mitigate potential risks.

* Perform many critical functions within the Threat Management discipline including staffing 24x7x365 coverage at the Citys Security Operations Center (SOC) augmenting FTE shift schedules including days, nights, weekends, and holidays.
* Interface with OTI Cyber Command teams internally, with City agencies, vendors, and information\-sharing partners.
* Monitor City networks and security alerts for intrusion, attempted compromise, and anomalous behavior;
* Apply mitigation techniques or escalation factors; correlate threat intelligence across various logs collected by established security controls.
* Produce routine SOC metrics \& reporting.
* Maintain situation reports (SITREPS) Perform weekly quality control checks.
* Work closely with SOC Director on incident preparation including the continuous development of new SOC playbooks and runbooks
* Handle special projects and initiatives as assigned.

* Interested applicants with other civil service titles who meet the preferred requirements should also submit a resume for consideration

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Why Citi**


Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.


As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.


Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.


**Why This Team**


The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) is home to deeply talented colleagues that work to ensure the safety of Citi's clients', our revenue, our employees and our proprietary data. We manage information security as one end\-to end program – one with a clear mandate and accountability. Our mission is a program that is fully anchored to modern control and architectural frameworks, is fully aligned with the enterprise architecture of the firm and is deeply integrated into the businesses and functions.


**About the Role**


Citi's Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management (OSVM) team is hiring practitioners who can run security assessments against AI systems and use AI\-powered tools to make security testing faster and more effective.


The AI Offensive Security Analyst is an operational role on a team that runs penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, and Red Team adversarial evaluations across Citi's application portfolio. The AI dimension is twofold: you'll test AI systems as a target, and you'll use AI tools as part of how you work. We're looking for someone to help build the tools from scratch and who knows how to get the most out of them, knows their limits, and can operate in an environment where the right approach isn't always obvious yet.


**What Makes This Different**


The problems we're solving don't have playbooks yet.


* **AI\-driven vulnerability management.** When frontier models can generate thousands of findings in a weekend, the bottleneck shifts from discovery to triage, verification, and remediation. We're building the pipeline that makes this sustainable.
* **Security architecture for the AI era.** Defining how a global bank deploys, monitors, and governs agentic AI — from standards and evaluation frameworks to production runtime monitoring.
* **AI at scale, not in a lab.** Citi has deployed AI tools to 180,000\+ employees, equipped 30,000 developers with AI coding assistants, and is rolling out agentic AI capabilities firm wide. Securing that footprint and the platforms that underpin them is the job.
* **Securing AI agents that can behave like insider threats.** Frontier models can harvest credentials, escape sandboxes, and adapt when they detect monitoring. We're designing the containment architectures and runtime controls to operate them safely at enterprise scale.
* **Real security engineering.** This isn't a cyber seat where you'll spend your time in administration . You will be expected to understand the code, the architecture, the threats, and find solutions. You'll have the mandate and the backing to build something meaningful.
* **Cyber Security Operations** — Detection, triage, and response for a world where adversaries use AI to find and exploit vulnerabilities faster than traditional detection can keep up. Behavioral analytics for AI agents. Playbooks for AI\-originated attack scenarios.

**What You'll Work On**


* **Testing AI applications and agents**. GenAI applications, agentic systems, and LLM\-backed products require testing that goes beyond standard web app methodology. Prompt injection, indirect injection, retrieval poisoning, tool misuse, sensitive data extraction, unsafe delegation, these are real attack classes with real business impact. jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast\-growing, and high\-performing network of public charter schools takes a village \- families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole\-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**About the Role**



The Program Manager, Safety \& Security, is responsible for planning and executing the programs, technology, and operational capabilities that enable Success Academy's enterprise Safety \& Security function. This role transforms operational challenges into scalable solutions that improve emergency preparedness, strengthen Command Center operations, modernize technology, and deliver consistent, high\-quality safety services across the organization.



Reporting to the Director of Safety \& Security, this role leads and owns Safety \& Security programs from design through execution, ensuring they are scalable, measurable, and continuously improving.



Success in this role requires exceptional program leadership, knowledge of modern security operations and technology platforms, and the ability to lead multiple high\-impact initiatives in a fast\-paced, innovative, and mission\-driven environment.

  


**What You'll Do**


* Design and lead enterprise programs that strengthen emergency preparedness, security operations, investigations, intelligence, and the 24/7 Success Academy Command Center to ensure lessons learned become lasting improvements that are scalable and replicable across the Success Academy network.
* Emergency preparedness responsibilities include planning drills, pressure testing policies and protocols, facilitating tabletop exercises, and conducting after\-action reviews.
* Continuously improve and innovate the operating procedures and governance processes that guide how Safety \& Security services are delivered across the enterprise for our scholars, staff, events, and school and office locations.
* Responsibilities include leading cross\-functional projects with Technology, Schooling, Legal, Supply Chain, HR, Communications, Operations, and other Network teams to implement new programs, improve workflows, and strengthen Safety \& Security programs and protocols.
* Support Command Center data integration and analytic reporting to identify security trends, refine operating procedures, review and evaluate service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs), and improve quality and efficiency of our safety and security operations.
* Coordinate enterprise response during significant incidents, ensuring the right people are engaged, leaders have timely information, and response efforts remain organized and effective.
* Continuously look for ways to improve how Safety \& Security operates—whether through technology, AI and automation tools, process redesign, vendor management, reporting, or new ways of working and thinking.
* Responsibilities include partnering with technology teams and vendors to implement new capabilities to organize and visualize data, improve existing platforms, automate manual work, and enhance the tools that support Safety \& Security operations and cultivate innovative problem solving.

**Qualifications**

As air travel scaled, what once relied on intuition and informal communication required entirely new operational systems: structured procedures, clear ownership, control mechanisms, and real\-time coordination that could maintain safety without slowing movement. Modern air traffic control didn't exist to restrict progress. It existed to make scale possible.



At Mercury, we're entering a similar phase of evolution.



As we work toward becoming a bank, we're building the operational foundations required to support that transition thoughtfully and responsibly. jobs.title: Data Analyst

The **Data Analyst** bridges raw enterprise data and strategic decision\-making by turning complex datasets into reliable, actionable insights. Working closely with product, operations, and technical teams, you will engineer clean data pipelines, run advanced SQL queries, build automated reporting dashboards, and conduct statistical analysis to solve core business problems and optimize operational efficiency.

* Write, optimize, and execute complex SQL scripts to extract, aggregate, and manipulate large volumes of structured and semi\-structured data across cloud data warehouses.

**2\. Dashboard Engineering \& Business Intelligence**

* Design, construct, and maintain interactive visual dashboards in enterprise BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, or Looker).

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish\-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our properties, which span digital, streaming, social, audio, linear and live events. We’re growing our offerings, building on the recent launch of our successful streaming platform, ViX. We were the fastest growing major media company in the U.S.


The Sales Operations Analyst supports the management, analysis, and optimization of linear advertising inventory across the portfolio. Working closely with Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, and other internal partners, the Analyst helps ensure inventory is accurately maintained, effectively utilized, and aligned with revenue and client\-delivery objectives. The role combines day\-to\-day inventory management with analytical problem solving and will increasingly leverage AI, automation, and data\-driven tools to identify inventory risks, recommend actions, and improve yield.

**ABOUT YOU**


The successful Sales Operations Analyst will move beyond simply reporting on inventory conditions to understanding why they exist and recommend what the business should do about them. Over time, as reporting and transactional work become increasingly automated, the role will place greater emphasis on analysis, exception management, validation of AI\-generated recommendations, and improving inventory utilization and yield.


You are an Excel rock star, who enjoys analyzing numbers and data to provide insights into our sales organization. For you, every challenge is an opportunity to find a solution.
