The **Senior Program Manager, Analytics, Automation \& Value Discovery** serves as the enterprise analytical discovery engine responsible for identifying, quantifying, prioritizing and enabling operational, financial, revenue, margin and performance improvement opportunities across VCA hospitals and support functions. The role connects disparate enterprise data, develops automated monitoring and exception\-based reporting, and builds business intelligence and AI\-enabled solutions that translate complex information into actionable insights. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Project Manager**  

  

**Caltech**  


**Job Category:** Fulltime Term  

**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  

**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  

  

Caltech is a world\-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  

  

**Job Summary**  

  

Caltech has just been awarded major National Science Foundation funding to build ELECTRA: a first\-of\-its\-kind, AI\-enabled automated laboratory for electron diffraction (MicroED) and structural elucidation that researchers anywhere in the country will be able to log in to and run real experiments on, over the cloud. ELECTRA is one node in a brand\-new nationwide network of NSF Programmable Cloud Laboratories, and we are building the founding team from the ground up: a cross\-disciplinary group of scientists and engineers from academia and industry who will turn this vision into a working national resource. The science this enables will ripple across chemistry, biology, and materials science, with real downstream applications in drug discovery, new materials, and medicine. Read more: https://www.nsf.gov/tip/updates/nsf\-announces\-400m\-investment\-new\-national\-network\-ai.  

  

As Project Manager, you will be the person who makes this ambitious, multi\-institution program actually run: owning the budget, compliance, and reporting, and serving as the connective tissue between the ELECTRA team, NSF, other PCL Nodes, and Caltech leadership.  

  

**Essential Job Duties**  

* Lead full life\-cycle program operations for a multi\-million\-dollar, multi\-institution award: budget tracking, timelines, deliverables, annual reviews and milestone progress, compliance (including research security and data policies), and NSF reporting across the entire PCL Node partnership.
* Serve as ELECTRA's primary liaison to the NSF program officer, other PCL Nodes, and the advisory board, representing the project in all outside activities and preparing reports, briefings, and presentations for NSF and institutional leadership.
* Maintain inter\-institutional collaboration and subaward agreements, keeping scope, budget, and data sharing aligned.
* Run program governance, including meeting cadence, risk analysis, and internal and external documentation, and track dependencies across the automation, software, and instrument teams to keep milestones on schedule.
* Organize user recruitment, onboarding workshops, and outreach events (including to R2 universities, primarily undergraduate institutions, and two\-year colleges), and manage external communications and web presence.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and coordination of node personnel.
* Lead development of the post\-award sustainability plan, including cost\-recovery models, industry engagement, follow\-on funding, technology transfer and IP activity with institutional tech transfer offices, and external evaluation and reporting metrics.

  

**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree and 2\+ years managing complex, federally funded research programs or equivalent experience.
* Experience managing NSF, NIH, DARPA, or comparable multi\-component awards with multi\-million\-dollar budgets and multiple institutional partners.
* Working knowledge of federal budget management, reporting, and compliance.
* Excellent written and oral communication, including drafting technical report content and preparing external presentations.
* Demonstrated independence coordinating scientists, engineers, administrators, and external partners.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Advanced degree in a scientific or technical field, with enough familiarity with laboratory automation, structural sciences, chemistry, materials, or biotechnology to engage substantively with the science.
* Experience running scientific workshops or building user communities.
* Shared user facility or core facility operations, including cost recovery and rate setting.
* Technology transfer, intellectual property, or industry partnership experience.
* Certified Research Administrator credential, or experience with Research.gov or comparable research administration systems, and with external program evaluation and metrics frameworks.

  

**Required Documents**  

* Resume
* Cover Letter

  

  

  

**To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings**  

  

*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Program Manager, Wildfire Preparedness (Los Angeles County)
jobs.description:
The Program Manager, Wildfire Preparedness will lead the regional implementation of CORE’s wildfire resilience and preparedness initiative in LA County, ensuring high\-quality program delivery, grant compliance, and community impact. This role provides strategic oversight of a grant\-funded wildfire preparedness program, including defensible space education, wildfire preparedness, vegetation management outreach, and community engagement activities.  

The Program Manager oversees regional program operations, supervises field staff, strengthens partnerships with community\-based organizations, local agencies, fire service partners and government stakeholders, and serves as the primary day\-to\-day contact for regional program implementation.  

The Program Manager closely monitors program performance, budgets, grant deliverables, and reporting requirements while advancing CORE’s mission to strengthen wildfire resilience and equitable disaster preparedness across vulnerable and high\-risk communities.  

This position may also be designated as a resource for national deployment to aid in various disaster scenarios as part of CORE's Emergency Response Team.  

Main Responsibilities

  

* Lead implementation of CORE’s wildfire resilience and preparedness programs across LA County, ensuring program goals, grant deliverables, and regional priorities are achieved.
* Guide the vision, development, and delivery of wildfire preparedness education and outreach programs, specifically aimed at the region's most vulnerable and rural populations.
* Monitor program operations, grant compliance, budgets, contracts, performance metrics, and reporting requirements.
* Lead regional outreach strategies, educational campaigns, presentations, and public engagement efforts focused on wildfire resilience.
* Oversee operational logistics including equipment, PPE, educational materials, and field resources.
* Maintain expertise in wildfire risk reduction strategies, fire weather, emergency alert systems, evacuation planning, and community preparedness resources while supporting public education.
* Lead, supervise, mentor and evaluate Program Coordinators, fellows, volunteers, and other assigned staff while fostering a collaborative and high performing regional team.
* Collect, analyze, and report program data to support grant reporting, continuous improvement, and strategic decision making.
* Represent CORE at regional meetings, coalitions, trainings, and public events related to wildfire resilience and emergency preparedness.
* Identify opportunities for program growth, partnership development, and future grant funding within the region.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

Scope \& Travel

  

* Supervise Program Coordinators and other assigned regional staff.
* Supervise California Emergency Response Corps Fellows and volunteers as assigned.
* Significant travel within Los Angeles County, including local field visits, partner meetings, trainings, conferences, and community events.
* Occasional travel throughout California to support regional collaboration, organizational meetings, and emergency deployments.
* Weekend availability for community engagement events.

  

Qualifications

  

* Bachelor's degree in emergency management, environmental science, forestry, natural resources, public administration, or a related field, (graduate\-level studies preferred; equivalent professional experience considered).
* Relevant certifications such as Wildland Firefighter/Field Crew, Certified Wildfire Mitigation Specialist, NFPA or Project Management Professional (PMP) are preferred.
* A driver’s license and access to reliable transportation capable of driving long distances in both rural and urban settings.
* Spanish bilingual proficiency preferred.

  

Experience:

  

* Minimum three years of progressively responsible experience managing grant\-funded wildfire resilience, climate resilience, emergency preparedness or community based environmental programs.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex regional programs, supervising staff and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience managing grant budgets, contracts, compliance requirements, and performance reporting.
* Demonstrable ability to assess wildfire risk areas, and develop targeted community resilience strategies
* Experience overseeing operational logistics, field resources, and equipment.
* Experience working with community\-based organizations, local governments, fire agencies, and regional coalitions.

  

Skills \& Competencies

  

* Deep understanding of wildfire home assessment and defensible space best practices.
* Strong data management, analysis, and grant reporting skills.
* Excellent relationship\-building and communication skills, with experience presenting to diverse audiences.
* Deep understanding of wildfire risk reduction, home assessment, defensible space practices, fire behavior, emergency management systems, and California wildfire policy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Excel, GIS (preferred), and other program management and reporting tools.
* Strong leadership, organizational, and project management skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, regional partnerships, competing deadlines, and evolving grant requirements.
* Flexible and adaptable in dynamic field and emergency response environments.

	+ Develop business cases, return\-on\-investment analyses, and implementation strategies for AI projects

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

jobs.title: Distribution Data Analyst - Bilingual
jobs.description:
**About UniUni**


UniUni, a North American leader in last\-mile logistics, delivers tens of millions of parcels annually in Canada, from Coast to Coast, and is rapidly expanding across the United States. Founded in 2019, UniUni’s tech\-driven innovation and crowdsourcing delivery model offers fast, economical, and reliable services to local, national, and international e\-commerce clients.

### **Job Overview**


We are looking for a Bilingual **Distribution Data Analyst** with strong data analytics capabilities, project execution skills, and excellent cross\-functional communication abilities.


In this role, you will support daily operational monitoring, sorting process optimization, and system feature implementation across sorting centers nationwide. You will leverage data analysis to uncover operational bottlenecks and collaborate closely with Warehouse Operations, Product, IT, Quality, and Management teams to drive issue resolution and continuous process improvement.


This position goes beyond pure report building and data monitoring—you will also deeply participate in testing and rolling out sorting systems, warehouse workflows, and new initiatives. It is an ideal role for candidates looking to build a multi\-faceted career blending **Operations, Data Analytics, and Project Management**.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1\. Sorting Operations Data Monitoring \& Analysis**

* Monitor core operational metrics across all US sorting centers, including sorting volume, automated vs. manual sorting ratios, departure timeliness, exception rates, unloading performance, package status, and process completion rates.
* Identify operational anomalies, process bottlenecks, and potential risks through data analysis, and follow up with local hubs to troubleshoot and implement fixes.
* Routinely compile operational performance and project data to provide actionable insights for executive leadership.

#### **2\. Dashboard \& Reporting Construction**

* Build and maintain operational Dashboards, daily/weekly reports, and ad\-hoc analytical frameworks based on business requirements.
* Extract, clean, analyze, and visualize data using Excel, Google Sheets, and other analytical tools.
* Continuously refine KPI definitions and data monitoring logic to enhance anomaly detection and operational management efficiency.

#### **3\. Sorting Process \& SOP Optimization**

* Gain a deep, hands\-on understanding of warehouse workflows, including sorting, consolidation/bagging, dispatch, unloading, and linehaul transportation.
* Identify efficiency gaps based on ground\-level operational feedback and drive process optimizations.
* Draft, update, and standardize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all hubs.
* Track post\-optimization performance and validate results using quantitative data.

#### **4\. System Testing \& Project Launch Execution**

* Serve as a primary liaison between Operations and Product/IT teams to collect and synthesize field system requirements.
* Participate in feature testing for sorting systems, handheld PDAs, and warehouse operational tools (including test scenario design, on\-site testing, bug logging, and post\-launch verification).
* Facilitate pilots, user training, and nationwide rollouts of new system features and operational workflows across hubs.
* Monitor system adoption and operational issues post\-launch, coordinating with technical teams for quick resolutions.

#### **5\. Cross\-Functional \& Multi\-Site Collaboration**

* Maintain daily communication with operational teams across nationwide sorting hubs to track operational exceptions and project execution.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering/IT, Quality, Transportation, and Finance teams to resolve complex cross\-departmental issues.
* Organize cross\-functional meetings, define clear Action Items, and track project milestones.
* Act as an effective bridge aligning business needs, system logic, and ground\-level warehouse operations.

### **Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **Language Requirement:** **Bilingual fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese is required** (written and spoken) to effectively communicate with bilingual ground ops, technical, and management teams.
* **Data Proficiency:** Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets.
* **Problem\-Solving Skills:** Proven ability to pinpoint root causes from complex data and business processes and propose actionable solutions.
* **Communication \& Coordination:** Exceptional interpersonal skills to collaborate seamlessly with warehouse staff, product managers, technical engineers, and leadership.
* **Ownership:** Strong self\-drive and accountability to manage projects independently and ensure end\-to\-end execution.
* **Adaptability:** Able to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.

### **Preferred Qualifications (Nice\-to\-Haves)**

* Experience in Logistics, Supply Chain, Warehousing, Last\-mile Delivery, or E\-commerce Fulfillment.
* Direct experience in Distribution Center (DC), Sorting Center, or Warehouse Operations.
* Background in software system testing, product requirement gathering, or project launch execution.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other BI visualization tools.
* Experience collaborating on cross\-regional or multi\-time\-zone projects.

### **What We Look For in You**


This role is a great fit if you:

* Are data\-driven, but don't want to be confined to just building static spreadsheets;
* Enjoy stepping onto the warehouse floor to understand actual ground operations;
* Proactively track problems to resolution rather than just reporting them;
* Can effectively translate between operational needs, data insights, and technical requirements;
* Love driving new initiatives and watching your solutions make a tangible impact on the business.

**JOB TITLE:** Sr. Lead Data Analyst, Merchant

**LOCATION:** Remote

**REPORTS TO:** Head of Data

 **﻿The Company**


Sunbit builds financial technology for real life. Our AI\-native platform helps more people get to “yes” at the moments that matter with personalized offers, transparent terms, and no added consumer fees. In stores, practices and service centers across the country, Sunbit provides a fast, fair pay\-over\-time option. For everything else, the Sunbit Credit Card delivers a modern, no\-fee credit experience managed in a powerful mobile app.


We are guided by people\-centered values: Serve Others Before Self, Include Always, Connect Genuinely, Innovate for Good. These values shape how we build, how we support customers and merchants, and how we work with each other.


What makes Sunbit different is an AI\-native infrastructure that runs through the full customer and merchant journey. Our interconnected AI systems power instant decisioning, streamline fraud checks with human\-in\-the\-loop safeguards, and enable highly personalized offers at scale. The result is a quick, fair, and simple experience for consumers and merchants.


We pair this technology with inclusion and transparency. Sunbit delivers industry\-leading approval rates — 90%\+ in auto service and 85%\+ in dental — while maintaining zero consumer fee\-based revenue. It is a better way to serve people and merchants, proven at scale.


Today, Sunbit is available across a nationwide, in\-person merchant network of 30,000\+ locations spanning auto service centers, dental and optical practices, veterinary clinics, and other specialty services. We help teams say “yes” more often and help customers move forward with confidence.

 **The Role:**


As a Senior Lead Data Analyst, you will serve as a strategic thought partner to Merchant leadership and key business stakeholders. This role goes beyond reporting on historical performance\- you will deliver proactive, data\-driven insights and actionable recommendations that influence business strategy and optimize portfolio performance. You will own complex analyses across the merchant and loan portfolios, identify growth opportunities and operational efficiencies, and develop scalable analytics solutions that enable data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. Your work will directly support high\-impact initiatives and help drive seamless operational execution.

  

Requirements:  

  

**What you’ll do:**

* **Executive Advisory \& Influence:** Serve as the primary analytical "North Star" for Merchant executive leadership, translating complex data into high\-stakes business strategy and actionable investment cases.
* **Visionary Roadmap Ownership:** Architect and evangelize a long\-term analytical roadmap that anticipates the needs of the Merchant and Loan portfolios, ensuring data capabilities scale ahead of business growth.
* **Institutionalize Data\-Driven Decisioning:** Build **predictive and prescriptive modeling**, to elevate merchant operations and loan management

sunday is building the fastest, simplest way to pay in restaurants. With a quick scan of a QR code, diners can pay, tip, and leave in about 10 seconds. We believe great products should feel obvious, not complicated, and we focus relentlessly on keeping things **simple** while earning **trust** from restaurants and guests at every interaction. Today, sunday powers payments in thousands of restaurants across the US, UK, and France, helping operators turn tables faster, increase tips, and unlock valuable insights. #### **About the Role**


As **PDQ Sales Program Manager** at sunday, your mission will be to drive the commercial performance of our **payment terminal business, also known as PDQ, in France**.


PDQ represents approximately 60% of French signings and is at the heart of our acquisition growth. You will own everything that drives this performance, from defining the ICP and pricing rules to rep enablement, outreach sequences, and the product feedback loop.


You will be the driving force behind the PDQ business in France. You will set the pace, identify performance levers, and ensure that action plans are effectively executed.


You will report directly to the Revenue Manager and work at the intersection of Sales, Product, Marketing, and Finance. This is a rare role with broad scope and real influence on the trajectory of sunday France.

  

Join early, grow fast, and shape the journey!

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**1\. PDQ Analytics and Performance**


You will be responsible for turning performance data into decisions, and decisions into results. You will not simply monitor PDQ activity. You will identify growth levers, define priorities, and mobilize teams to activate them.

* Manage PDQ activity on a daily and long\-term basis, identifying gaps against targets, growth opportunities, and priority actions to implement with sales managers and reps.
* Produce and lead weekly and monthly PDQ business reviews covering new logos, PDQ GTV, conversion rate, deal cycle, PDQ versus QR mix, and performance by team and rep. The objective is not only to present the numbers, but to generate decisions and action plans.

* Define and maintain the complete PDQ ICP framework, including target profiles by establishment type, size, and location, as well as the recommended sales approach, pricing, and signing rules.
* Work with Finance and the Revenue Manager to formalize discount rules.
* Ensure that every PDQ rep has clear decision guidelines covering which customers to sign and under what conditions.

**3\. PDQ enablement and training, from knowledge to adoption**

* Organize regular PDQ call shadowing sessions, and design and lead dedicated training sessions covering pitches, objections, payment\-terminal use cases, and pricing.
* Keep all sales and training materials continuously up to date.

**4\. PDQ GTM coordination, outreach, and Revenue Engineering**

* Coordinate with GTM Engineering on PDQ targeting lists, including payment\-terminal ICP criteria and enrichment, outbound sequences, and A/B tests.
* Coordinate with Marketing on PDQ campaigns, positioning, and referral programs.
* Prioritize the PDQ Revenue Engineering backlog with the Head of Sales Excellence.

**5\. PDQ product feedback loop and Voice of the Customer**

* Collect feedback from the field and share it with the Product team in an actionable format.
* Work closely with Payment Terminal Operations on post\-sale topics, including installation, adoption, and early churn.
* Lead win/loss analyses on payment\-terminal deals and contribute to the PDQ roadmap.

* Comfortable driving cross\-functional projects across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product without direct reporting authority.
* Experience in a high\-growth environment. SaaS, FinTech, or payments experience is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Proton**

**Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default**



Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: **privacy is a fundamental human right**. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!



We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top \~1% of applicants. Our 700\+ team members across 50\+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high\-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. !

  


**Role Overview**



The Security Analyst will be at the frontline of protecting Proton’s global infrastructure. This role combines analytical threat investigation with practical security engineering, taking a role in running, tuning, and evolving our detection capabilities.



You will bridge the gap between day\-to\-day security monitoring and proactive threat defense. Sitting within our security team, you will not only respond to alerts and manage incidents but actively design the rules, playbooks, and systems that catch attackers before they succeed. We value deep logical reasoning, data\-driven intuition, and strong cross\-functional communication.

  


**What you will do:**


**Threat Detection \& SIEM Engineering**


* Maintain, optimize, and enhance our core security monitoring toolkit (SIEM, sensors, etc.).
* Design, build, and continuously refine meaningful alerts, transforming raw infrastructure events into high\-fidelity detections.
* Proactively identify malicious activities or blind spots within our network and infrastructure that our current toolsets might not cover.


**Incident Response \& Monitoring**


* Monitor, triage, and deeply investigate security alerts covering all of Proton’s corporate infrastructure.
* Own the containment and mitigation of potential security incidents, orchestrating quick and effective response actions.
* Develop, document, and test rigorous incident response plans and actionable playbooks to streamline future workflows.


**Risk Mitigation \& System Security**


* Analyze complex logs, endpoints, and network traffic to isolate anomalies, extract patterns, and identify emerging risks.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy and maintain secure architectures, applying server and system security best practices (e.g., OS hardening, strict access controls).
* Contribute to continuous posture improvement by feeding operational findings back into security tooling and roadmaps.


**Governance**


* Support, advise, and guide the wider company on all security\-related matters and emerging risks.
* Participate in business process documentation, operational metric reporting, and the strategic automation of security tasks.
* Promote a culture of strong IT security awareness and responsible user behavior across our distributed teams.

  


**Job requirements**


* Good logical reasoning, structure, and problem\-solving skills. The ability to correlate diverse data sources, extract hidden patterns from massive volumes of data, and think like an attacker.
* Solid understanding of system and network security best practices, including network ACLs, authentication mechanisms, and endpoint defense configurations.
* Strong working knowledge of Linux\-based operating systems, their architectural security components, system calls, and mechanisms like SELinux.
* Familiarity with modern malware techniques, attacker tactics (TTPs), and how to translate this threat intelligence directly into actionable SIEM rulesets.
* Sound understanding of networking protocols, web technologies, and detection mechanics (eg. EDR, IDS/IPS).
* Intermediate\-to\-advanced proficiency in Python (or similar languages) for scripting, parsing, and automation tasks.
* Excellent written and spoken English, paired with strong communication and organizational skills to collaborate smoothly across different teams.
* A deep belief in digital privacy.


**Preferred qualifications**


* Proven experience (ideally 3\-4 years) in a cybersecurity or operations context.
* Hands\-on experience working with Elastic stack, Vector, or other tools used in large\-scale log analysis.
* Experience utilizing data analysis tools (such as Jupyter, Pandas) to hunt for anomalies.
* Practical knowledge of securing and analyzing containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes) and Cloud infrastructure environments.
* Experience in leveraging and integrating Threat Intelligence into security workflows.
* An industry\-recognized security certification is considered a strong asset.


**Success in This Role**


* The SIEM environment is highly tuned, resulting in a demonstrable reduction in false positives and a significant increase in high\-value, actionable alerts.
* Security incidents are quickly contained, thoroughly investigated, and translated into resilient long\-term containment strategies and playbooks.
* Threat detection coverage expands smoothly to secure new infrastructure, products, and cloud microservices.

  


**What We Offer**


* **Work that Matters:** millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable.
* **Stock Options:** at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
* **Technology:** you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.

You will play a central role in ensuring project governance, planning, execution discipline, stakeholder coordination and consolidated reporting.


This is a transversal role requiring strong project management discipline, excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to operate in an evolving strategic environment.

You will coordinate the day\-to\-day delivery of a new project, ensuring that workstreams are properly structured, milestones are tracked, risks and issues are escalated, and key decisions are prepared for management.


The project will cover the full lifecycle of the initiative.

jobs.title: Data analyst F/H - stage
jobs.description:
**Notre groupe :**


Fondée en 1974, mk2 est une maison de cinéma indépendante de référence en Europe. Depuis cinquante ans, le groupe déploie un modèle intégré qui réunit l’ensemble des métiers du cinéma : production, distribution, ventes internationales, exploitation, hôtellerie, médias et expériences culturelles. Des films aux salles, mk2 défend une autre vision du cinéma : exigeante, ouverte et profondément tournée vers les publics. Portée par trois valeurs — sélection, altérité, transmission — cette ambition se prolonge dans l’accompagnement des œuvres avec un catalogue unique de plus de 1 000 films, la programmation de ses cinémas, réunissant plus de 7 millions de spectateurs chaque année et le déploiement de formats culturels contemporains qui prolongent l’expérience du cinéma.

**Le poste :**


Vous rejoignez l’équipe Exploitation / Contrôle de gestion, directement impliquée dans le pilotage opérationnel des salles mk2\.


Votre mission : plonger au cœur des données générées par VISTA et HORIZON, nos outils métiers qui centralisent l’ensemble des informations liées aux séances, à la billetterie, aux ventes et plus largement à l’activité de nos cinémas.

* **VISTA** : logiciel métier utilisé par les cinémas pour la programmation, la billetterie, la gestion des séances et des ventes (billets, concessions…).
* **HORIZON** : outil de consolidation permettant de centraliser, historiser et structurer les données issues de VISTA afin de les transformer en indicateurs exploitables par les équipes Exploitation, Finance et Contrôle de gestion.

**Les missions :**

**1\.** **Exploration \& compréhension des systèmes (mission centrale)**

* Participer à la cartographie des tables, champs et relations entre les données VISTA et HORIZON.
* Comprendre le fonctionnement des différents modules VISTA : programmation, billetterie, concessions, caisses et opérations.
* Analyser les traitements et flux de données entre VISTA et HORIZON.
* Identifier les éventuelles incohérences, anomalies ou doublons dans les données.
* Contribuer à la documentation des structures, flux et règles métiers afin de faciliter leur compréhension et leur utilisation.

**2\. Organisation et fiabilisation des données**

* Participer à la mise en place de contrôles qualité automatisés permettant de fiabiliser les données.
* Contribuer à la structuration des nomenclatures, mappings et conventions d'exploitation entre VISTA et HORIZON.
* Vérifier la cohérence des données consolidées avec l’activité réelle des salles.

**3\. Reporting et tableaux de bord**

* Participer à la création et à l’amélioration de tableaux de bord portant notamment sur :


	+ la programmation et les séances ;
	+ la fréquentation et le taux de remplissage ;
	+ les ventes billetterie et concessions ;
	+ les principaux indicateurs utilisés par l'exploitation et le contrôle de gestion.
* Contribuer à l’automatisation des reportings récurrents afin de simplifier leur production et de limiter les manipulations manuelles.

**Ce stage est à pourvoir pour une durée de 6 moi à compter de début septembre 2026\.**

**Le profil que nous recherchons :**

* Étudiant(e) Bac\+4/5 en école d’ingénieur, école spécialisée data, école de commerce (orientation data/finance), ou université (statistiques / économie / informatique).
* Maîtrise indispensable de :


	+ SQL
	+ Excel avancé
	+ Outils de dataviz (Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio…).
* Méthodique, rigoureux(se), curieux(se), avec le goût de comprendre la logique d’un système avant de le structurer.
* Bonus : intérêt pour les systèmes d’exploitation cinéma ou les logiciels métier (VISTA, POS, gestion de salles…).

**Pourquoi rejoindre mk2 ?**

* Participer au développement de nos lieux et expériences mk2
* Intégrer une équipe passionnée et dynamique qui valorise l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative
* Contribuer directement sur la croissance d'un groupe en pleine expansion et tourné vers l'innovation

jobs.title: Business Analyst (H/F)
jobs.description:
Fondé en 1981, le Groupe Beaumanoir est un acteur majeur et incontournable du prêt\-à\-porter en France. Avec plus de 15 000 collaborateurs, 2700 points de vente dans le monde et 10 sites logistiques en France (C\-LOG), le Groupe Beaumanoir opère aujourd'hui plus de 20 marques emblématiques (Cache Cache, Bréal, Bonobo, Jennyfer, Vib's, La Halle, Naf Naf, Morgan, Caroll, Sarenza.com, Quiksilver, Roxy, Billabong, DC Shoes, Element, RVCA...) qui couvrent l'ensemble des univers de la mode et du lifestyle.


Pionnier de la distribution digitale depuis 2005 et pure player web, Sarenza.com c’est aussi une e\-destination mode qui propose vêtements, chaussures et accessoires.
Présent dans 22 pays en Europe, avec une sélection de plus de 500 marques et 60 000 références, le site s’appuie sur des piliers forts : la bonne offre, au meilleur prix pour toute la famille. Ses forces : la livraison garantie sous 24 heures en France et un service client internalisé, de nombreuses fois primé.  

Rattaché au pôle Data, Business performance, Pricing \& Promotion, le Business Analyst participe à la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie tarifaire de Sarenza à l'échelle internationale. Il collabore étroitement avec différentes équipes pour assurer l’accroissement du chiffre d’affaires, l'optimisation des prix, l'efficacité des promotions et la rentabilité globale de Sarenza.

#### **1\. Pilotage de la Performance Commerciale \& Stratégie (\~40%)**

* **Suivi et business reviews :** Assurer le suivi quotidien et l'analyse des performances commerciales et mettre en place des plans d’actions correctifs.
* **Stratégie commerciale \& budgétaire :** Participer au processus de construction des objectifs annuels des pays.
* **Bilans et études ad hoc :** Réaliser des bilans approfondis des opérations commerciales et mener des analyses poussées sur des sujets divers pour éclairer les décisions stratégiques.

#### **2\. Opérations Pricing \& Promotion (\~40%)**

* **Déploiement promotionnel :** Créer des offres promotionnelles personnalisées (listings promos, codes promos) pour les différents pays en alignement avec les objectifs fixés par la direction.
* **Stratégie tarifaire :** Participer à la définition de la stratégie de prix globale et formuler des recommandations stratégiques basées sur les performances passées et les ambitions budgétaires.
* **Suivi et bilan du plan d'action commerciale :** Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes métiers pour coordonner le plan d'action commerciale tout en assurant l'historisation des opérations afin de mener des retours d'expérience et d'en évaluer l'efficacité.

#### **3\. Optimisation des Outils, Data \& Reporting (\~20%)**

* **Automatisation :** Développer des requêtes SQL pour automatiser et optimiser les processus métiers.
* **Data Visualisation :** Créer et optimiser des tableaux de bord dynamiques (via Tableau Software) pour faciliter le pilotage par les équipes.

*Note : Cette liste n'est pas limitative. Le poste étant très stratégique et transverse, les missions pourront s’enrichir en fonction de votre proactivité et des projets en cours.*

* **Formation :** Étudiant(e) en Master 2, idéalement en école de commerce, avec un intérêt pour l’analyse et le pricing
* **Compétences souhaitées :**
	+ Maîtrise d'Excel et notions basiques en SQL
	+ Expérience avec un outil de data visualisation (Tableau Software serait un atout)
	+ Connaissance du e\-commerce et/ou du retail
* **Qualités personnelles :**
	+ Adaptabilité : capacité à (re)prioriser des sujets en cours pour répondre aux besoins business

Job Category


Operations
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


L'équipe *Sales Strategy \& Operations* (Stratégie \& Opérations Commerciales) est une fonction à fort impact qui travaille en partenariat direct avec la direction commerciale pour stimuler une croissance rentable et exécuter efficacement la stratégie de mise sur le marché ( *Go\-To\-Market* ). Positionnée à la croisée de la stratégie, de l'analyse de données et de la rigueur opérationnelle, l'équipe recherche un(e) Analyste s'épanouissant dans cet environnement.


Ce poste combine stratégie d'entreprise, analyse avancée et opérations commerciales pour transformer les données en synthèses claires, construire des processus évolutifs et influencer les décisions au niveau exécutif.


### **Vos missions**

* **Stratégie \& Conception GTM :** Participer à la conception et à l'exécution de la stratégie annuelle *Sales Go\-To\-Market* , incluant la segmentation des comptes, la modélisation des capacités, l'alignement des territoires et la fixation des quotas.
* **Reporting \& Tableaux de bord :** Définir les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et concevoir des tableaux de bord permettant d'évaluer la santé de l'activité et de déceler des opportunités de croissance.
* **Analyses approfondies :** Synthétiser les données relatives au pipeline, aux revenus et à l'atteinte des objectifs afin d'identifier les tendances, les risques et les opportunités, tout en les traduisant en recommandations concrètes.
* **Support aux prévisions (** ***Forecast*** **) :** Collaborer avec les responsables commerciaux et les *Strategy Business Partners* pour améliorer la fiabilité des prévisions et la rigueur de suivi à travers les différentes entités.
* **Savoir\-faire décisionnel (** ***Executive Storytelling*** **) :** Concevoir des présentations de haute qualité pour les revues trimestrielles ( *QBR* ) et les cycles de planification stratégique, en traduisant des données complexes en synthèses percutantes.
* **Excellence opérationnelle :** Identifier et résoudre les points de friction opérationnels pour améliorer la productivité commerciale et favoriser l'optimisation continue des processus.

**Exemples de projets types :** Conception de la couverture GTM, analyse de la santé du pipeline, rigueur des prévisions, diagnostic de la performance commerciale et soutien au rythme opérationnel de la direction.


### **Profil recherché (Qualifications minimales)**

* **2 à 4 ans d'expérience** pertinente en stratégie commerciale pour le secteur *enterprise technology* , opérations, conseil en stratégie/management, banque d'investissement, FP\&A ou tout autre poste analytique équivalent.
* **Maitrise avancée** de Google Sheets.
* **Excellentes compétences en présentation** sur Google Slides.
* **Diplôme de niveau Bac\+5 / Master** (ou équivalent) en mathématiques, économie, comptabilité, gestion/finance, statistiques ou domaine connexe, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.
* **Capacité à exécuter avec rapidité et précision** dans un environnement technologique à fort rythme.
* **Capacité démontrée à utiliser les outils d'IA** pour accélérer le travail analytique et opérationnel.
* **Curiosité intellectuelle** et volonté d'industrialiser les processus par l'automatisation et des méthodes réutilisables.
* **Connaissances en SQL** ou outils de requête de données similaires.

### **Qualifications appréciées (Un plus)**

* Expérience avec **Tableau Desktop** et **Salesforce CRM** .
* Connaissance des modèles économiques de logiciels par abonnement ( *SaaS / Subscription* ).
* Excellentes capacités de communication écrite et orale, avec une expérience de présentation devant des interlocuteurs séniors.

Unleash Your Potential

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. * Full\-time
* Directorate: IEA

**Company Description**
-----------------------


The Organisation for Economic Co\-operation and Development (OECD) is an international organisation comprised of 38 member countries, that works to build better policies for better lives. Our mission is to promote policies that will improve the economic and social well\-being of people around the world. Together with governments, policy makers and citizens, we work on establishing evidence\-based international standards, and finding solutions to a range of social, economic and environmental challenges. From improving economic performance and creating jobs to fostering strong education and fighting international tax evasion, we provide a unique forum and knowledge hub for data and analysis, exchange of experiences, best\-practice sharing, and advice on public policies and international standard\-setting.


The International Energy Agency (IEA) is an intergovernmental organisation committed to advancing security of energy supply, economic growth and environmental sustainability through energy policy co\-operation. The IEA operates as an autonomous body within the framework of the Organisation for Economic Co\-operation and Development (OECD).


The IEA seeks to recruit Electricity Grids and Security Analysts to contribute to its analytical work on grids and electrification in the Electricity Systems and Markets Division (ESM). The Electricity Gris and Security Analysts will support the Division’s work on electricity security, with a particular focus on transmission and distribution system modernisation. This includes to analyse and model power systems from physical and technoeconomic perspectives, and to draft grid\-focused projects.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Main Responsibilities**


Modelling, analysis and drafting

* Lead the Division’s technical, analytical and modelling work on power systems, grid modernisation (transmission and distribution), and electricity security.
* Lead analytical work on the system integration of emerging sources of electricity demand and generation, with a focus on operational security, reliability and resilience.
* Analyse developments in congestion management, grid connection processes, and strategic grid planning across key power markets.
* Monitor innovations and operational practices aimed at enabling more efficient use of grids, including Grid Ehancing Technologies (GETs), digital solutions, and regulatory frameworks.
* Contribute to the delivery of the IEA’s Electricity Security programme and to drafting grid\-related content for the IEA’s *Electricity* report and other relevant ESM publications.


Collaboration and outreach

* Engage with key industry stakeholders; support preparations as needed for meetings of IEA standing committees, working parties and other groups as required; participate in relevant meetings of other international organisations; provide support for the development of reports, analyses and information items for these meetings.
**Qualifications**
------------------

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

**Academic Background**

* Advanced university degree or PhD in Electrical / Power / Energy Systems Engineering, Energy Economics, Physics or a related discipline.

**Professional Background**

* At least five years to seven years of direct power systems work experience in the electricity industry, economic consulting, grid technology companies, or at an electric regulatory agency working on transmission or distribution networks, system operation, energy management and related fields.
* Strong technical background in power systems and in\-depth understanding of electricity security concepts, power market fundamentals, and the interaction between system operations and market incentives.
* Solid knowledge of medium\- and low\-voltage distribution grids, with an understanding of the frameworks governing connection processes and the integration of distributed energy resources.
* Experience with network planning and operational practices aimed at enhancing the efficiency and utilisation of existing infrastructure is desirable.
* Experience with power system modelling, such as steady‑state network modelling, dynamic and transient stability modelling, or grid planning and expansion studies, would be an advantage.
* Proven analytical abilities and excellent writing skills as demonstrated in past work products (analytical reports, quantitative analysis, operative models, and/or published papers).

**Tools**

* Excellent command of Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.
* Experience with SQL or Power Query is an asset.
* Solid knowledge of relevant coding languages (e.g. Python).
* Experience with relevant grid modelling software (e.g. PowerFactory, PSS, PSCAD) would be an advantage.

**Languages**

* Excellent written and oral command of English, including drafting and proofreading.
* Knowledge of one or more other working languages would be an asset.

jobs.title: CS27 BAC+5 - Data Analyst (H/F)
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

RENAULT s.a.s.
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Contexte et environnement de travail :**

Renault Group poursuit son engagement envers les jeunes au travers la formation par l’alternance et les stages.


Réalisez votre stage au sein de Renault Group et transformez vos connaissances en compétences sur des projets concrets.


Accompagné par un tuteur et d’équipes expertes, vous progressez vers votre diplôme dans un cadre exigeant et bienveillant.


Une expérience utile, formatrice et porteuse de sens, quelle que soit la fonction.


La Direction de l'Ingénierie Renault Group s'appuie sur des moyens de simulation immersive de pointe afin d'accélérer le développement et la validation des véhicules et des systèmes d'aide à la conduite de demain.


Au sein de l'équipe **RGE\-DS (Renault Group Engineering \- Driving Simulation)** basée au Technocentre de Guyancourt, vous évoluerez dans un environnement innovant dédié à la simulation immersive Driver\-in\-the\-Loop (DiL). L'équipe exploite notamment le simulateur **ROADS** , l'un des moyens de simulation les plus avancés du groupe, permettant de reproduire de manière réaliste l'expérience de conduite afin d'évaluer des véhicules, des fonctions ADAS et de nouvelles technologies avant leur mise sur route.


Dans le cadre de l'amélioration continue de nos méthodes de mise au point, de nombreux utilisateurs (pilotes d'essais, ingénieurs de mise au point, experts véhicules et métiers AD/ADAS) exploitent quotidiennement les données générées lors des simulations. Aujourd'hui, l'analyse de ces données et la production de supports d'aide à la décision nécessitent encore de nombreuses opérations manuelles.


L'objectif de ce stage est de définir puis développer une solution permettant de transformer automatiquement les données issues des simulations en rapports métiers exploitables immédiatement après les séances.  



**Vos missions** **:**

Au cours de votre stage, vous serez amené à intervenir sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la solution.


Phase 1 : Analyse du besoin métier


* Rencontrer les différentes populations utilisatrices des simulateurs immersifs.
* Comprendre leurs processus de mise au point et leurs besoins d'analyse.
* Identifier les indicateurs, courbes et synthèses les plus pertinents pour l'exploitation des simulations.
* Formaliser les besoins fonctionnels et proposer différents concepts de restitution des données.
* Définir avec les utilisateurs le format cible des rapports automatisés.
Phase 2 : Compréhension de l'environnement technique


* Découvrir l'écosystème de simulation immersive Renault.
* Comprendre le fonctionnement du logiciel de simulation **SCANeR** et les données générées lors des essais.
* Identifier les sources de données nécessaires à la construction des rapports.
* Étudier les architectures techniques adaptées au besoin.
Phase 3 : Développement de la solution


* Concevoir et mettre en œuvre une solution automatisée de génération de rapports.
* Développer les algorithmes de traitement et d'extraction des données.
* Mettre en place des visualisations pertinentes permettant une interprétation rapide des résultats.
* Automatiser la génération et la mise à disposition des rapports à l'issue des simulations.
* Valider la solution avec les utilisateurs finaux.
Phase 4 : Industrialisation


* Documenter l'architecture de la solution.
* Rédiger la documentation utilisateur et technique.
* Assurer le transfert de connaissances auprès de l'équipe.
* Proposer des pistes d'évolution pour les futurs développements.
**Les apports du stage**

Ce stage vous permettra de :


* Découvrir les technologies de simulation immersive utilisées pour le développement automobile.
* Travailler au contact direct des métiers de la validation véhicule et des systèmes ADAS.
* Participer à un projet à fort impact sur les méthodes de mise au point du Groupe.
* Monter en compétences sur la gestion de données, l'analyse métier et l'automatisation de processus.
* Développer une solution pouvant être utilisée quotidiennement par les équipes de simulation.
**Qui êtes\-vous ?**

* Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau **Bac\+5** en école d'ingénieur ou université avec une spécialisation en i nformatique / Data Science / Systèmes embarqués / Génie logiciel / Traitement de données
* Vous possédez les compétences suivantes : Capacités d'analyse et de synthèse ; curiosité et intérêt pour la compréhension des besoins utilisateurs ; Bon niveau en développement logiciel (Python ou équivalent) ; Connaissances en traitement et visualisation de données ; Esprit d'initiative et autonomie ; Aisance relationnelle pour interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés.
* Des connaissances en simulation, en automobile ou en outils d'analyse de données seraient un plus.
**Pourquoi rejoindre Renault Group ?**

Rejoindre Renault Group, c’est bien plus qu’intégrer un grand nom de l’industrie automobile. C’est faire le choix d’une entreprise engagée, innovante et résolument tournée vers un avenir durable.


Nous réinventons l’industrie pour la rendre plus circulaire, plus responsable et plus inclusive.


Chez Renault Group, nous croyons que chaque talent mérite un accompagnement à la hauteur de ses ambitions. C’est pourquoi nous proposons :


* Un environnement de travail stimulant, inclusif et flexible,

Ingéniance , entreprise française créée il y a plus de 19 ans , est un pure player dans l'IT, spécialisée en finance de marché . Nous sommes fiers de collaborer avec des grands comptes tels que BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole, Société Générale, BPCE , ainsi qu'avec un secteur de l' assurance en plein essor.
  

  

Cette longévité témoigne de notre capacité à offrir des solutions innovantes et performantes à nos clients dans des environnements complexes.
  

  

Notre expertise repose sur le développement logiciel , la data et la méthodologie agile .
  

  

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
\\n
* Expertise reconnue : Une solide expérience et des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur financier.
* Clients prestigieux : Collaboration avec des leaders du marché (banques, assurances).
* Environnement agile et humain : Taille humaine, approche agile, proximité avec les équipes et évolution continue.
* Projets stimulants : Participer à des projets innovants et de transformation digitale.

Contexte de la mission
  

  

Nous recherchons notre futur **Business Analyst spécialisé en titrisation** pour structurer et accompagner des projets liés aux **opérations de titrisation**, avec un objectif de qualité, de conformité réglementaire et d'efficacité opérationnelle.
  

  

Vos missions seront les suivantes :
* Recueil et formalisation des besoins métiers ;
* Analyse des structures de titrisation (deals, cash flows, collatéral) ;
* Rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles et suivi des recettes ;
* Coordination entre métiers, IT et parties prenantes externes ;
* Suivi des données des portefeuilles titrisés et production des reportings (investisseurs et réglementaires) ;

Rejoignez\-nous pour construire l'avenir de la finance et de l'IT.

jobs.title: Business Analyst F/H
jobs.description:
CDI
Créteil, France
35000 \- 60000 €/an
**Mission générale**
--------------------


Au sein de la Direction Data \& Expérience Client, le/la Business Analyst est garant(e) de la production, de la fiabilité et de la valorisation des données au service du pilotage de l'activité. Il/elle conçoit des outils d'aide à la décision (tableaux de bord, indicateurs, études) à destination des équipes métiers, en France comme à l'international, et contribue directement aux enjeux de performance commerciale et de maîtrise des coûts du Groupe.


**Détails de l’offre**
----------------------


* Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord de pilotage sous Power BI


* Recueillir les besoins auprès des équipes métiers (commerce, marketing, finance, opérations) et les traduire en indicateurs et solutions data exploitables


* Réaliser des analyses de données permettant d'identifier les leviers d'action prioritaires et les axes d'amélioration pour les équipes métiers.


* Assurer un pilotage dans la durée des indicateurs clés (KPI), en suivant les écarts et en alertant les équipes métiers en cas de dérive


* Prendre en charge l'analyse des résultats d'enquêtes (volet Analytics), incluant l'automatisation des traitements et la systématisation de la diffusion des résultats aux responsables de secteur.


* Travailler en mode transverse avec des référents métiers en France et à l'international afin de comprendre leurs besoins et d'y répondre par des livrables adaptés à l'échelle Groupe.

**Profil et expérience**
------------------------


* Formation Bac\+4/5 (école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou université) avec une spécialisation Data / Business Analytics.


* Première expérience réussie (stage, alternance ou poste junior) sur des missions de data analyse ou de business intelligence.


* Anglais professionnel apprécié compte tenu des interactions avec des interlocuteurs internationaux



Vos compétences techniques :



* Maîtrise avancée de Power BI (modélisation de données, DAX, création de dashboards et administration)


* Maîtrise de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles pour l'extraction et la structuration de la donnée


* Bonne connaissance du CRM Microsoft Dynamics et des problématiques de qualité de données associées


* Capacité à automatiser des traitements de données récurrents (Python, Power Query) pour fiabiliser et accélérer la restitution



Votre savoir\-être et vos compétences transverses :



* Sens de l'analyse développé : capacité à transformer un volume de données complexe en constats clairs et actionnables.


* Rigueur, fiabilité et autonomie dans la conduite des sujets confiés.


* Posture professionnelle affirmée et orientation entreprise/résultats.


* Appétence marquée pour les sujets complexes, abordés avec curiosité intellectuelle et engagement.


* Capacité à évoluer dans des contextes transverses et internationaux, en lien avec des interlocuteurs multiples.

**À propos de nous**
--------------------


Elior, filiale d'Elior Group, est n°1 en restauration collective en France. Depuis plus de 25 ans, nous anticipons les évolutions de notre métier, en devançant les attentes et les besoins des enfants, élèves, étudiants, travailleurs, patients et résidents…



Rejoindre Elior France, c'est rejoindre 17 000 collaborateurs engagés sur l'un de nos 100 métiers, qu'il s'agisse de fonctions opérationnelles ou de fonctions support. Nos 3 500 restaurants sont répartis sur toute la France.  

Faire partie de nos équipes fonction support, c'est apporter votre soutien aux équipes opérationnelles pour les aider à satisfaire quotidiennement nos clients et convives. C'est également l'opportunité d'intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution qui vous permettra d'enrichir votre expertise et vos compétences.



Comme nous, venez exprimer votre passion de la cuisine et du service, et évoluer dans un Groupe qui favorise la réussite par le collectif et le collaboratif.

jobs.title: Project Manager- Municipal Infrastructure
jobs.description:
### **About Parametrix**



Parametrix is a 100% employee\-owned consulting firm helping clients deliver resilient infrastructure, vibrant and livable communities, and environmentally sustainable solutions. We are a team of professional construction managers, engineers, management consultants, planners, scientists, and surveyors dedicated to delivering outstanding client service. We build lasting partnerships and collaborate with our clients to envision possibilities and create tomorrow, together.



Recognized as a top workplace, we're committed to a culture that values work\-life balance, professional growth, and the well\-being of our people.

### **About the Opportunity**



We are looking for a Project Manager to join our Advisory Services team and oversee project activities across multiple disciplines, ensuring alignment with client goals and milestones. You will manage processes such as contracting, procurement, deliverables production, risk management, and document control, while leading the development of project management plans and procedures.



Our team works for a variety of clients including water/wastewater, transit and transportation, and environmental planning and compliance providing planning and design services, as well as, owner's, program, and delivery advisory services. We are proud to have an established relationship with a range of clients, providing us the opportunity to support the communities in which we live and work.


**Your Role on the Team:**


* Oversee project activities across multiple disciplines, including planning and design services, as well as, owner's advisory services, procurement, construction management, strategic communications, Equity \& Social Justice (ESJ), outreach and engagement, and other functions.
* Bring expertise in understanding of client goals through comprehensive project scheduling, cost estimating, risk management, work package planning, and process oversight, while maintaining accurate tracking and reporting.
* Lead the creation and implementation of project management plans and procedures, supporting efficient project execution.
* Provide expertise in contract analysis, value engineering, and risk assessments to enhance project planning and execution strategies.
* Participate in business development, RFP support, and client presentations, contributing to department growth and project pursuit efforts.


**What You Bring to the Team:**


* 5\+ years of progressive multi\-disciplinary project management experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience overseeing complex, multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Experience working directly with municipal clients and agencies.
* Alternative/collaborative delivery experience is preferred.
* Experience with contract analysis, constructability reviews, value engineering studies, and risk assessments.
* PMP or other relevant certification is preferred.

### **Why Join Parametrix?**


**Employee Ownership \& Great Benefits:** As a 100% employee\-owned company, you will share in and contribute to Parametrix's success. You will earn stock in your Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) account and be an important contributor to our collective achievements.



Our Benefits include:


* Comprehensive Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, short\- \& long\-term disability insurance)
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (financial profit sharing)
* Performance\-based bonuses
* 401(k) Plan
* Paid Time Off (both vacation \& sick/wellness time accruals)
* Paid Holidays
* Parental Bonding Leave


**Exciting, Award\-Winning Project Work:** Our work earns recognition for its innovation and positive impact on communities, giving you the opportunity to contribute to projects that make a difference. Learn more at https://www.parametrix.com/our\-work/


**Flexible Work Arrangements:** We understand the importance of work\-life balance and offer flexible work arrangements to support our employee\-owners' diverse needs. Whether it is hybrid, remote, or in\-office, we provide options that allow you to work in a way that best suits your lifestyle while staying connected and engaged with your team.


Compensation is determined by factors such as education, experience, location, and role. As employee\-owners, we are eligible for performance\-based bonuses and our salaries are reviewed annually. We value transparency and look forward to discussing our compensation structure.


### **Our Commitment to You**



Parametrix is committed to being an inclusive workplace, where team members of all backgrounds and experiences are welcome. As an equal opportunity employer, it is our policy and culture to provide opportunities to all persons based on merit and fitness to perform job duties. Employment decisions are based solely on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, religion, age (40 or older, as protected under the ADEA), disability (including physical, mental, or sensory), genetic information (including testing and characteristics), protected veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws or regulations.



At Parametrix, we are dedicated to encouraging an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure your needs are met. We welcome and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Sr Compliance Data Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account**

  

Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile\-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.

**About the Role**
------------------


Happen Bank’s Compliance Team is looking for an experienced compliance data analytics professional to join the team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining various reports and processes to support the Compliance organization.**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Conduct tuning of existing BSA/AML transaction monitoring models/rules and watchlist screening processes; develop new processes as needed
* Execute on initiatives to streamline operational processes related to ad\-hoc reporting and ongoing performance monitoring related to BSA/AML and regulatory compliance
* Enhance and Develop Community\-Reinvestment Act (CRA) reporting to support the strategic plan
* Provide support for other Compliance related initiatives and activities as needed, including internal and external audits or regulatory exams and strategic projects; Collaborate with partners across Compliance, Technology, Model Risk Management, and Data Engineering to support deliverables
* Perform ongoing User\-Acceptance Testing (UAT) to support new products/channels, ensuring coverage in transaction monitoring, customer risk rating, and screening models as required
* Use creativity, analytical expertise, and sound judgment to identify and mitigate risk
* Use AI tools fluently and stay current on new AI use cases, methods and bring them into your work thoughtfully
* Assist in preparing periodic reporting materials for executive leadership
* Assist in regulatory exam readiness and internal audit reviews

**About You**
-------------

* 2\-5 years of analytics experience with technical proficiencies in SQL, RStudio, Python, etc.
* 2\+ years of compliance/financial crimes compliance experience in a regulated financial institution with a background in fintech preferred
* Knowledge of BSA/AML laws and regulations, including but not limited to the Bank Secrecy Act, the USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC/sanctions requirements, Equal Credit Opportunity Act, the Fair Housing Act, CRA and other laws and regulations related to fair and responsible banking; CAMS or other AML certification is a plus
* Experience and inquisitive in the use of AI tools as part of your analytical toolkit — for exploration, pattern recognition, and modeling
* Effective communicator who can tailor discussions to various audiences; You have the ability to simplify complex analysis for non\-technical audiences
* Passion for driving change with an ability to navigate multiple high and sometimes competing priorities
* Strong problem\-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity
* Bachelor’s degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience

**Work Location**  

San Francisco, Lehi, New York  

  

The above locations are eligible offices for this role. The locations have been determined to foster in\-person collaboration with this role’s team or the related business lines. We utilize a hybrid work model, and our teams are in\-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In\-person attendance is essential for this role’s success, and remote placement will not be considered. Happen Bank offers relocation, based on actual job level.
  

  

**Time Zone Requirements**  

Local hours (PT, MT, ET)  

  

While the position will primarily work local hours, Happen Bank is headquartered in Pacific Time and our ideal candidate will be flexible working across time zones when necessary.  

  

**Travel Requirements**  

As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed.
  

  

**Compensation**  

The target base salary range for this position is 81,000\-125,000\. The base salary of the role will be determined by job\-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. Base salary is just one part of Happen Bank's Total Rewards package. You may also be eligible for long\-term awards (equity) and an annual bonus (which is based on company performance, employee performance and eligible earnings).  

  

We’re creating new financial services solutions for our members based on fairness, simplicity, and heart, and we treat our employees the same way. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision plans for employees and their families, 401(k) match, health and wellness programs, flexible time off policies for salaried employees, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave and more.

\#LI\-AH1

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We believe that a variety of perspectives will make our teams and business stronger as we work together to transform the traditional banking system.

jobs.title: Creative Project Manager - Emerging Brands
jobs.description:
**ABOUT KENDO**


Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco\-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy \- Louis Vuitton, the world's largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.



Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market\-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct\-to\-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:


* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone's voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It's our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever\- constant, and agility is our strength.
* Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.


The salary range for this position is $120,110 \- $133,455 per year. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in\-office, with Monday and Friday remote.



Kendo Total Rewards offerings also include an annual bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental and vision insurance, flex paid time off program, parental leave, employee discount/perks, a retirement plan with employer contributions, Summer Fridays, opportunity to work from anywhere for two weeks during the calendar year and December wellness/shutdown week for applicable positions.





The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.


**SUMMARY**



We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager to join our creative team, supporting the Emerging Brands (Ole Henriksen \& Lip Lab) divisions. This role is critical in ensuring the successful and timely execution of all creative projects. You'll own GTM and digital timelines for the brands, serving as the creative team's primary point of contact for print and digital projects. While embedded within the creative team due to the significant creative input required for most projects, this individual will be instrumental in fostering seamless collaboration between brand, marketing, and creative departments to ensure all initiatives launch on schedule with all necessary assets.





**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Partner with stakeholders across brand, marketing, and creative teams to define project scopes, establish timelines, and manage project lifecycles within Asana.
* Efficiently manage project intake and conversion processes within Workfront.
* Drive projects forward, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure deadlines are met.
* Lead and facilitate weekly creative status, review and project kickoff meetings.
* Accurately capture, distribute, and follow up on meeting notes, action items, and other critical inter\-team communications.
* Successfully manage a diverse portfolio of concurrent digital projects across multiple brands.
* Continuously identify opportunities for process improvements and workflow optimization to enhance team efficiency and project delivery.


**REQUIREMENTS**


* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of progressive project management experience, with a strong preference for digital project management within a creative or marketing environment.
* Expert\-level proficiency in project management software, including Asana and Adobe Creative Suite (specifically ProofHQ and Workfront).
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Exceptional organizational skills with a keen eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* PMP Certification is a plus.
